title: Heroes
description: Hero roster with class, rarity, generation and how to obtain them, plus the concepts (rarities, generations, event roles) needed to build a hero strategy. Per-event star ratings are filled in knowledge/hero_event_ratings.json.
sources: Kingshot Optimizer hero card list (screenshots shared by user)
user notes on rarities, roles and generation gating

R.focus: Growth / utility. Can fight (mainly early game) but the focus is utility.

SR.focus: Support or situational heroes in battle.

generations.gating: Heroes are NOT all available at once: they unlock as the game progresses and the kingdom ages, grouped by generation. Any hero strategy must match the player's CURRENT generation — e.g. don't plan around a G5 hero for a player still in the G2 era.
generations.note: In this list all R and SR heroes are Gen 1; SSR heroes span G1..G7.

role_notes.arena_vs_conquest: Arena and Conquest are SEPARATE roles even though guides often print them together as 'Arena/Conquest'. A hero's Arena (champion) ability and its Conquest ability are distinct, and different events rely on one or the other. Keep and rate them independently; fill in as heroes get detailed.

aliases.$comment: Naming varies by tutorial author: 'PvP Joiner' and 'Rally Joiner' mean the same role.

epic_recruitment_gold_keys.summary: In the Hero Hall (NOT the 'Hall of Heroes'), 'Epic Recruitment' spends Gold Keys to pull heroes.
epic_recruitment_gold_keys.loot_pool_progression: At the start only Jabel + the starter purple/blue heroes are in the pool (Diana is the exception — she has her own acquisition event). Each new generation adds the heroes from TWO generations prior into the Gold Key pool: at Gen 4 the Gen 2 mythics (Marlin, Hilde, Zoe) are added; at Gen 5 the Gen 3 heroes (Petra, Eric, Jaeger) are added; and so on.
epic_recruitment_gold_keys.exceptions: The pay-to-win Gen 1 heroes Helga and Amadeus never enter the Gold Key pool (pack purchase only). Saul is also excluded from Gold Keys, but can still be built with Hall of Heroes tickets (tickets are buyable in limited quantities with gems), as an alternative to orange shards.

hero_systems.skill_books: Hero skills are upgraded with skill books; there are separate Conquest and Expedition skill sets per hero. Investing a few Conquest skill books in an early hero (e.g. Olive) can buy an early-game edge, but heroes are a depreciating asset — plan to transition combat investment to stronger heroes over time.
hero_systems.leveling: Every hero starts at Lv.1 and can be raised to a maximum of Lv.80.

stars_and_shards.mechanic: Each star is completed by filling 6 parts with shards. Each part may require a different number of shards, but the total to complete a given star is fixed. Example for one full star: 1 + 1 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 shards.
stars_and_shards.note: The per-star numbers are the cost of completing THAT star; they sum to 1065 to reach 5 stars.

shard_types.overview: Two categories of shards: GENERAL Hero Shards (rarity-matched, shared across heroes of that rarity) and HERO-SPECIFIC (exclusive) Shards pre-assigned to one hero. For almost every hero you can exchange General Hero Shards of the matching rarity for that hero's fragments.

general_by_rarity.blue_rare: Rare Hero Shards (Blue) — upgrade Rare (R) heroes. Sources: Intel Missions, Conquest, Hero Hall, VIP Shop, special events, packs.
general_by_rarity.purple_epic: Epic Hero Shards (Purple) — upgrade Epic (SR) heroes. Sources: Intel Missions, Conquest, Hero Hall, Alliance Shop, VIP Shop, Terrors, events, packs.
general_by_rarity.gold_mythic: Mythic Hero Shards (Gold, aka 'orange'/generic) — upgrade Mythic (SSR) heroes. Scarce and shared across all SSR heroes, so which hero to spend them on is a key decision. Sources: Arena leaderboards, Intel Missions (later generations), Fishing Event, VIP Shop, Swordland Shop, some Conquest levels, hero recruitment, events, packs.

shard_types.exclusive: Hero-specific shards pre-assigned to one hero (exist for SSR and SR heroes).
shard_types.general_shard_exception: Amadeus and Helga are exclusive heroes that can ONLY be upgraded with their own Hero-Specific Shards — you CANNOT convert General Hero Shards for them (pack purchase only). Every other hero can be built by exchanging matching-rarity General Hero Shards for their fragments.

hero_systems.note: Hero gear is fully portable between heroes (see knowledge/hero_gear.json) — it is NOT tied to a specific hero.
hero_systems.exclusive_gear: Distinct from normal portable hero gear: some heroes (notably Mythics like Jabel) have their OWN hero-specific 'Exclusive Gear' (e.g. Jabel's Greaves of Faith) that only that hero can equip. It grants extra hero/escort stats plus its own Conquest and Expedition gear-skills, upgraded with widgets. Low-spenders should be careful not to over-invest widgets into exclusive gear for roles (e.g. garrison defense lead) they won't actually perform.
hero_systems.talent: Some heroes (e.g. Helga's 'Power of the Deer') have a Talent: an account-wide passive that applies to ALL deployed troops even when the hero is not in the march, scaling with the hero's star level. This is the most durable long-term value of some P2W heroes since it persists after they are cycled out of combat.

leveling_table.summary: Hero XP requirements per level (1-80). Heroes use Hero XP to upgrade to a max level of 80. Higher level increases the hero's Escorts in the arena and its troop capacity.

columns.tc_required: Town Center level required to reach this hero level.
columns.hero_xp: Hero XP needed to go from the previous level to this one (null at level 1, which is the starting level).
columns.cumulative_xp: Total Hero XP spent to reach this level from level 1.
columns.troop_capacity: Hero's troop capacity at this level.
columns.escorts: Number of arena escorts at this level.

leveling_table.source_notes: Values verbatim from Kingshot Optimizer. Note a likely source typo around levels 39-40 (troop_capacity 7,840 then 7,775 — non-monotonic).

entries.name: Olive
entries.summary: Boosts food production and clears early Conquest levels.

details.role_focus: Growth/economy (food); brief early-game AoE combat value.

conquest.name: Rain of Arrows
conquest.effect: Launches a hail of arrows for AoE damage around the target (Attack x252% at L5).

conquest.name: Target Lock
conquest.effect: Raises damage dealt to the target for this attack (+30% at L5).

expedition.name: Green Thumb
expedition.effect: Increases the Town's Mill Output (+25% at L5). Applies whether or not Olive is in the march.

expedition.name: Forager's Luck
expedition.effect: Increases her Bread Gathering Speed in the Wilderness (+25% at L5); needs Olive in the gathering march.

details.strategy: Early-game food economy specialist. Both Expedition skills raise food output (Green Thumb = passive Mill output; Forager's Luck = faster bread gathering when she marches), giving lasting economic value even after she leaves the combat roster. In Conquest/Arena she is surprisingly effective in a kingdom's opening weeks thanks to Rain of Arrows (one of the earliest AoE attacks) plus her damage buff, letting players push Conquest stages fast (which increases account income). She falls off quickly once Epic (purple) heroes like Diana arrive and outclass her stats/abilities.
details.investment: Safe to put a few Conquest skill books into her for an early Conquest push, then transition her out of combat as stronger Epic heroes arrive and keep her as a permanent gathering specialist. Do NOT use her on Bear Hunt (leader or joiner) — her growth skills waste combat slots.

entries.name: Forrest
entries.summary: Boosts wood production and does little else.

details.role_focus: Growth/economy (wood); no viable combat role.

conquest.name: Axe Whirl
conquest.effect: Axe pirouette deals Attack x110% per 0.5s to nearby enemies for 3s (AoE).

conquest.name: Razor Sharp
conquest.effect: Sharpened axe deals more damage per second (+30% at L5).

expedition.name: Woodland Inheritor
expedition.effect: Increases the Town's Sawmill Output (+25% at L5). Applies whether or not Forrest is in the march.

expedition.name: Master Woodcutter
expedition.effect: Increases Wood Gathering Speed in the Wilderness (+25% at L5); needs Forrest in the gathering march.

details.strategy: Dedicated wood economy hero. Woodland Inheritor passively boosts Sawmill output (works even off-march), and Master Woodcutter speeds wood gathering when he leads the gathering march; since wood fuels endless building and tech upgrades, he stays useful for account growth for the whole life of the account even though he never enters the combat roster. In Conquest/Arena he fails: his kit (Axe Whirl AoE + Razor Sharp) is offensive, but infantry stats are built to tank and survive for backline damage dealers. He must stand next to enemies to attack, exposing himself without the durability to survive, and as a low-rarity hero his damage multipliers do not justify the risk. Use him purely for gathering.
details.investment: Farmable/formable, so easy to feed. Worth building his Expedition skills for the passive wood output/gathering speed. Do NOT invest Conquest skill books or orange shards in him for combat — that value is better spent elsewhere.
details.story: Two-meter bald giant with a beard and a jagged scar; looks like an outlaw but is the town's go-to for unruly children, a side-gig to his main trade of woodcutting.

entries.name: Edwin
entries.summary: Boosts stone production and does little else.

details.role_focus: Growth/economy (stone); no viable combat role.

conquest.name: Shrapnel Load
conquest.effect: Throws a homemade explosive for AoE damage to the target and nearby enemies (Attack x196% at L5).

conquest.name: Detonate
conquest.effect: Explosives have a chance to stun targets (20% chance at L5). Inconsistent at low levels.

expedition.name: Demolitions Expert
expedition.effect: Increases the Town's Quarry Output (+25% at L5). Applies whether or not Edwin is in the march.

expedition.name: Stone Mining
expedition.effect: Increases Stone Mining Speed in the Wilderness (+25% at L5); needs Edwin in the gathering march.

details.strategy: Dedicated stone economy hero (the cavalry counterpart to Forrest for wood). Demolitions Expert passively boosts Quarry output (works off-march) and Stone Mining speeds stone gathering when he leads the march; great for bypassing the stone bottlenecks that slow account progression, but he offers effectively zero combat utility for rallies or Bear Hunt. In Conquest/Arena he is a suboptimal cavalry hero: his AoE (Shrapnel Load) is outclassed by other blue heroes like Olive, and his stun (Detonate) is too inconsistent at low levels to matter. He lacks the base stats to deal damage while surviving, so keep him out of combat lineups.
details.investment: Farmable/formable. Worth pushing his star level (to ~4 stars) to maximize stone acquisition, but keep him out of active expedition combat marches. Save Conquest skill books for better heroes; only max his tactical skills for completion's sake once resources are plentiful.
details.story: An intelligent oddball, too clever to be a village idiot but too strange for most; quiet at work but full of wild ideas once drinking. Valued for the steady stream of stone he mines at the local quarry.

entries.name: Seth
entries.summary: Boosts iron production; useful as a second tank in early game Arena and Conquest.

details.role_focus: Growth/economy (iron); doubles as an early-game 2nd tank in Conquest/Arena.

conquest.name: Hammer Burn
conquest.effect: Swings his hammer in a devastating arc for single-target damage (Attack x280% at L5).

conquest.name: Armor Enhancement
conquest.effect: Upgrades his armor to reduce damage taken (-30% at L5). Key skill that makes him a durable frontline tank.

expedition.name: Burnished Iron
expedition.effect: Increases the Town's Iron Output (+25% at L5). Applies whether or not Seth is in the march.

expedition.name: Craftsmanship
expedition.effect: Increases his Iron Mining Speed in the Wilderness (+25% at L5); needs Seth in the gathering march.

details.strategy: Iron economy hero (completes the resource quartet with Olive/food, Forrest/wood, Edwin/stone). Burnished Iron passively boosts Iron output (off-march) and Craftsmanship speeds iron gathering when he marches. Unlike the other growth heroes, Seth is genuinely useful in early combat: Armor Enhancement (-30% damage taken) plus the largest health pool among the starter blues makes him an excellent 2nd-slot tank behind Howard for the first ~40-50 days, keeping backline damage dealers alive. His AoE/attack does decent but not field-clearing damage. F2P players should eventually replace him in combat with Zoe (Gen 2), but keep him for the long-term iron economy.
details.investment: Farmable/formable and a high-priority pick for F2P players who need a second tank early. Push his star level (to ~4 stars) for iron acquisition; his Armor Enhancement makes tactical-skill investment worthwhile in the early game (better value than Forrest/Edwin combat). Transition combat duty to Zoe in Gen 2.
details.story: A smith by trade whose real passion is writing novels; his horror short 'The Mysterious Case of the Missing Miner' was a hit with everyone literate except Edwin, who dismissed it as 'penny dreadful garbage'.

entries.name: Diana
entries.summary: Saves stamina, speeds up marches and helps with early game Conquest.

details.role_focus: Utility/economy (stamina saver + march speed); strong early-game AoE in Conquest/Arena.

conquest.name: Incendiary Arrows
conquest.effect: Fires an incendiary shot: Attack x290% to the target + Attack x98% AoE to nearby enemies (values at L5). Great at clearing escort troops, but has a long cast time and poor targeting (can waste shots on lone targets).

conquest.name: Sharpshooter
conquest.effect: Increases Attack Speed (+30% at L5).

conquest.name: Deadly Strike
conquest.effect: Increases her Crit Rate (+20% at L5).

expedition.name: Iron Constitution
expedition.effect: Reduces Governor Stamina Cost of wilderness attacks/rallies (-20% at L5). Signature utility skill.

expedition.name: Quick Paced
expedition.effect: Increases Hunting (PvE) March Speed (+100% at L5), effectively doubling march speed to PvE targets.

details.strategy: Near-mandatory early growth hero. Her Expedition kit is pure utility: Iron Constitution cuts stamina cost by up to 20% and Quick Paced doubles PvE march speed, letting you convert stamina into far more resources/shards/gear — essential for stamina-heavy events (e.g. Cesare's Fury, Beast Slay). BUT she gives lower troop atk/def than other purples and no combat troop buffs, so swap her out of combat marches like Bear Hunt for offensive buffers (Chenko, Yeonwoo). In Conquest/Arena she is a strong early AoE dealer because her shards are so easy to farm (Desert Trial event), so she is often higher-starred than other epics in the first 50-60 days. Best placed in the 'back left' safety slot for uptime. Eventually outclassed by Quinn (single-target burst) or Yeonwoo (reliable AoE) once they catch up in stars.
details.investment: Build her star level immediately — shards are cheaply farmed from the Desert Trial event (her own event; she is NOT in the Gold Key pool). High-priority for stamina efficiency and early tactical formations. Keep her Expedition value forever, but plan to replace her combat role with Chenko/Yeonwoo/Quinn later.
details.story: Youngest of the wilderness rangers cavalry group, famous for her red hair and fighting skill; her rite of passage is to face a Netherfiend alone in the dark desert.

entries.name: Quinn
entries.summary: Most F2P-friendly early game combat archer, high single-target damage in Arena.

details.role_focus: Combat DPS (single-target burst) archer; best F2P-farmable combat archer of Gen 1.

conquest.name: Headshot
conquest.effect: Upgraded crossbow deals massive single-target damage (Attack x560% at L5) — one of the highest multipliers in the game, made to delete a single enemy hero before they cycle their ultimate.

conquest.name: Quick Shot
conquest.effect: Increases his Attack Speed (+30% at L5).

conquest.name: Natural Selection
conquest.effect: Increases his damage dealt (+30% at L5).

expedition.name: Sixth Sense
expedition.effect: Reduces damage taken by all troops (-20% at L5). This is his rally-joiner contribution, but weaker than Gordon's +25% health; its defensive nature also makes him a poor Bear Hunt joiner.

expedition.name: Precision Shot
expedition.effect: Grants all soldiers a 50% chance to deal 50% more damage when attacking (at L5). Makes him the only purple archer with 2 combat expedition abilities; great for solo marches.

details.strategy: The go-to F2P combat archer of Gen 1 (arguably alongside Saul). In Expedition his first skill Sixth Sense is defensive (army-wide -20% damage), so as a rally joiner he is weaker than Gordon and a poor Bear Hunt joiner, but Precision Shot (50% chance for +50% damage) plus a class-leading +140.11% archer atk/def (higher than Diana) make him excellent in solo wilderness marches and solo expeditions. In Conquest/Arena he is a glass-cannon single-target burst dealer: Headshot has one of the highest multipliers in the game to delete a high-threat enemy hero, backed by Quick Shot (atk speed) and Natural Selection (flat damage). Rotate him against AoE heroes (Diana/Yeonwoo) based on enemy formation — pick Quinn when you need to neutralize a specific threat. Staple tactical hero through Gen 1.
details.investment: Best easily-farmable archer for players who cannot/would rather not invest in Saul during Gen 1. Expect to use him for solo marches and rally leading until later generations, ideally replacing him with Marlin (Gen 2). Good PvP Joiner but frequently overrated (his joiner skill is defensive, not offensive).
details.story: A thrill-seeking hedonist whose one principle is that everyone is ultimately on their own; renowned for his figure, wit, and crossbow skill.

entries.name: Chenko
entries.summary: The must-have joiner hero for any alliance content.

details.role_focus: Elite rally joiner (army-wide lethality buff); solid early AoE dealer in Conquest/Arena.

conquest.name: Burst Fire
conquest.effect: Rapid barrage dealing Attack x75% to enemies in front every 0.5s for 2s (cone AoE at L5). Devastates grouped enemies but has finicky targeting — can hit lone units or fire away from the fight if positioned poorly.

conquest.name: Defense Upgrade
conquest.effect: Upgrades her armor, increasing Defense (+70% at L5).

conquest.name: Weapon Upgrade
conquest.effect: Boosts her base Attack (+24% at L5).

expedition.name: Stand of Arms
expedition.effect: Increases the total Squads' Lethality (+25% at L5). Her signature joiner buff — army-wide lethality for Bear Hunt/rallies/garrison breaks.

expedition.name: Shield Wall
expedition.effect: Reduces damage taken by all troops (-20% at L5).

details.strategy: Mandatory alliance joiner and staple for every member. Her signature Stand of Arms gives a 25% army-wide lethality buff, essential for Bear Hunt and breaking tough garrisons. IMPORTANT stacking rules: lethality stacks ADDITIVELY when multiple players join with Chenko or Yeonwoo, and MULTIPLICATIVELY with other skill types like Amane's Tri-Phalanx, so coordinated alliances scale damage hugely (the joke 'the difference between a bad and good Bear Hunt is ~four Chenkos' is literal). Shield Wall adds army-wide -20% damage, but her main value is pushing offensive output as a joiner. In Conquest/Arena she is a strong AoE dealer via Burst Fire (cone barrage), but positioning is critical — it often mis-targets. Weapon Upgrade boosts her attack. Lower base attack than Quinn but reliable AoE + farmable shards keep her top-priority until later-gen powerhouses (Marlin, Margot) outclass her.
details.investment: High-priority build for anyone focused on alliance event income — nearly every player should build her for the joiner role. Easily farmed shards. Keep her for combat in Conquest/Arena through Gen 1; combat role eventually ceded to Marlin/Margot, but the joiner value persists.
details.story: An inventor who looks more like a runaway or fugitive, wielding an enormous blunderbuss ('lightning stick'); delights in testing her inventions on Rebels and predators alike.

entries.name: Howard
entries.summary: Ubiquitous early game F2P infantry hero for Expedition and Arena.

details.role_focus: Premier early-game tank / defensive infantry; core Conquest and rally-lead hero.

conquest.name: Shielded Strike
conquest.effect: Whacks an enemy with his heavy shield, knocking the target back while dealing Attack x280% AoE damage (at L5). The knockback displaces the enemy front line, interrupting attacks and boosting Howard's tank uptime.

conquest.name: Joint Defense
conquest.effect: Increases Defense for ALL heroes on the field (+15% at L5). The only passive stat buff among purple heroes that buffs every hero's defense.

conquest.name: Shield Block
conquest.effect: Upgraded shield reduces his damage taken (-30% at L5).

expedition.name: Defenders' Edge
expedition.effect: Reduces damage taken by all troops (-20% at L5). His rally-joiner contribution; provably inferior to Gordon's +25% health because the combat formula treats -20% damage the same as Gordon's 25%.

expedition.name: Weaken
expedition.effect: Reduces the total Enemy Squads' Attack (-20% at L5).

details.strategy: Foundational F2P infantry and the premier purple tank. In Conquest/Arena he does the most important infantry job — keeping backline damage dealers alive — via elite mitigation and crowd control: Shielded Strike knocks back the enemy front line (interrupting attacks, extending his own uptime), Shield Block gives him -30% self damage, and Joint Defense uniquely buffs every hero's defense. He stays a tactical staple for most players until at least Gen 3. In Expedition his Defenders' Edge (-20% army damage) makes him a decent first-slot joiner for defensive rallies and solo marches, but it is provably inferior to Gordon's +25% health in coordinated garrisons (combat formula treats -20% damage = Gordon's 25%). Highest hero health of the Gen 1 tanks (26,640).
details.investment: Mandatory build — the best F2P infantry at game start and your main infantry rally hero until replaced by Zoe (Gen 2) for F2P. Remains Conquest-relevant for multiple generations due to limited F2P-accessible infantry. Good PvP Joiner but frequently overrated (his joiner skill is defensive and weaker than Gordon's health buff).
details.story: A distinguished guardsman of the Sixth Imperial Cavalry whose finest moment was holding the near-indefensible southern wall against General Cesares; the only unit to hold, which made the Imperial bureaucracy look bad and got him cast out and warranted for arrest.

entries.name: Gordon
entries.summary: Joiner hero for alliance PvP content (especially Garrison); potential second tank in early Arena.

details.role_focus: Best F2P PvP defensive joiner (+25% army health); situational support/'third tank' in Conquest/Arena.

conquest.name: BBQ Feast
conquest.effect: Restores Health by Attack x280% to all troops AND increases Attack by 7% for all troops for 4s (values at L5). A team-wide heal plus minor attack buff.

conquest.name: Culinary Chaos
conquest.effect: Reduces his damage taken (-30% at L5).

conquest.name: Emergency Snack
conquest.effect: Restores Health equal to Attack x70% every 5s (self-heal over time, at L5). Slow to trigger.

expedition.name: Super Nutrients
expedition.effect: Increases total Squads' Health (+25% at L5). His signature joiner buff — the single best early-game defensive buff for F2P, superior to -20% damage skills (Howard/Quinn) and stacks multiplicatively with later different-skillcode 25% defensive bonuses.

expedition.name: Trash Talk
expedition.effect: Increases the total Squads' Attack (+25% at L5).

details.strategy: Premier F2P PvP defensive joiner. Super Nutrients (+25% army health) is the best early defensive buff available and is provably superior to the -20% damage skills of Howard/Quinn (combat formula treats -20% damage the same as 25%, but Gordon's is a full 25% health); sending multiple Gordons in the lead joiner slot gives coordinated alliances huge survivability for holding castles/outposts/sanctuaries. It also stacks MULTIPLICATIVELY with later 25%-equivalent defensive bonuses that use different skillcodes. In Conquest/Arena he is the only hero with a heal at game start (BBQ Feast team heal + minor attack buff; Emergency Snack self-heal; Culinary Chaos -30% self damage), but as cavalry he has a smaller health pool than infantry — even below a maxed blue Seth — so he often dies before his slow heals trigger. Play him backline as a support/'third tank' to buy time for damage dealers to cycle AoE.
details.investment: Priority build for PvP — push to at least 4 stars to unlock max Super Nutrients for Castle Battle / Kingdom vs Kingdom defensive formations. His +25% health joiner buff beats Howard's defensive joiner skill. As a combat tank he is only situational (backline support), not a front-line replacement.
details.story: A workaholic cook whose work ethic is legendary — the governor jokes he'd pay silver for Gordon to learn 'the art of resting'; Gordon never stops working or talking, even in his sleep.

entries.name: Fahd
entries.summary: Build hero for his unique PvP joiner ability, which keeps him relevant in later generations.

details.role_focus: Niche PvP rally joiner (rare-skillcode enemy damage debuff); weak in Conquest/Arena.

conquest.name: Sandstorm
conquest.effect: Reduces all Enemy Squads' Attack (-5% at L5) for only 2s. Crippled by short 2s uptime and a slow ~7s initial cast delay (fires after most enemies launch their signature abilities).

conquest.name: Eagle Wings
conquest.effect: After Sandstorm, increases his and nearby friendly Squads' Attack (+35% at L5) for 2s. Often wasted — most damage dealers already cycled their signatures before it triggers and may be out of range.

conquest.name: Dune General
conquest.effect: Increases his Attack Speed (+30% at L5). Personal buff that clashes with his intended team-support role and low attack stat.

expedition.name: Desert Eclipse
expedition.effect: Reduces all Enemy Squads' Damage Dealt (-20% at L5). His saving grace: statistically inferior to Gordon's +25% but uses a very UNCOMMON skillcode, raising the chance it multiplies with other joiners' skills in a large rally.

expedition.name: Pathfinder
expedition.effect: Increases Solo Hunting (PvE) March Speed (+100% at L5). Limited utility.

details.strategy: A niche joiner, not a combat hero. His value is entirely Desert Eclipse (-20% enemy damage dealt): although statistically weaker than Gordon's +25% health, it uses a very uncommon skillcode, so it is likely to stack MULTIPLICATIVELY with other joiners' skills in a big coordinated rally, raising the alliance's effective damage-mitigation multiplier — which keeps him relevant into later generations for well-coordinated alliances. Pathfinder (+100% solo PvE march speed) has minor QoL use, most notably pairing him with Diana in the archer slot so she returns faster to recast her stamina-saving skill (useful for scoring quickly in Beast Slay or Alliance Brawl). In Conquest/Arena he is weak: Sandstorm's debuff is tiny with 2s uptime and a slow 7s cast, Eagle Wings usually triggers too late/out of range, and Dune General is a selfish buff that fights his support role.
details.investment: Not a priority — build him mainly for his unique joiner skillcode for coordinated PvP rallies. Only invest Conquest skills for completionist reasons after all other primary purple heroes are maxed. Skip if you are not the type to buy the monthly card / do not need the Diana march-cycle trick.
details.story: A desert cavalry commander whose circling eagle warns his ranks of ambushes; he presses low against his horse through biting wind and swirling sand to launch counterattacks on ambushers.

entries.name: Amane
entries.summary: A growth hero whose best ability is actually a combat skill.

details.role_focus: Bear Hunt / rally joiner (+25% army attack, multiplicative with lethality); weak Conquest/Arena.

conquest.name: Sakura Blossom
conquest.effect: Buffs all Heroes and Escorts: +3.5% Attack and +4.5% Attack Speed for 4s (at L5). Support skill hampered by a slow ~7s cast — often benefits arrive after decisive ultimates fire.

conquest.name: Fire Sigil
conquest.effect: Lobs a fiery sigil for single-target damage (Attack x210% at L5).

conquest.name: Divine Melody
conquest.effect: Every 3 basic attacks increases her Attack Speed by 5% until end of battle (stacking scaling at L5).

expedition.name: Tri-Phalanx
expedition.effect: Increases all Squads' total Attack (+25% at L5). Her signature joiner buff — equivalently valuable to Chenko/Yeonwoo's 25% lethality, and MULTIPLICATIVE with lethality (whereas stacking lethality alone is only additive).

expedition.name: Exorcism
expedition.effect: Increases Infirmary Healing Speed (+50% at L5, additive). Least valuable of the Gen 1 growth abilities — many other ways to boost healing speed and low impact on account tempo.

details.strategy: Nominally a growth hero, but her real value is combat: Tri-Phalanx (+25% army attack) is the KEY joiner buff. Per the damage formula it is equal in value to Chenko/Yeonwoo's 25% lethality BUT multiplies with lethality, while stacking lethality bonuses alone is only additive — so the optimal Bear Hunt/rally comp mixes Amane's attack joiners with Chenko/Yeonwoo lethality joiners to maximize total damage. This gives her lasting value in Bear Hunt and in attack rallies that dislodge garrison defenders in Castle Battle. Her growth skill Exorcism (+50% infirmary healing) is the weakest Gen 1 growth ability. In Conquest/Arena she is low-priority: Sakura Blossom's buff is small with a slow 7s cast, and although Divine Melody scales her attack speed over time, she lacks Quinn's burst or Diana/Yeonwoo's AoE to exploit it.
details.investment: Build her for the joiner role (Tri-Phalanx) — she is a core piece of the optimal rally-damage stack alongside Chenko/Yeonwoo. Save Conquest skill books for stronger damage dealers; only invest her tactical skills once the primary roster is established.
details.story: A clumsy, kind-hearted foreigner new to the city (nearly knocks over a fruit stall, hands out candy as apology); the Kingdom had her working the Infirmary until the Bear arrived.

entries.name: Yeonwoo
entries.summary: Amazing research-boosting growth hero and Arena AoE dealer in one package.

details.role_focus: Elite growth (research) + Bear Hunt/rally lethality joiner + premier early AoE dealer — three roles in one.

conquest.name: Petalbloom
conquest.effect: Arcs outward in three waves dealing Attack x100%, then 2nd wave (up to 175% at L5), then a 3rd-wave AoE blast (up to 210% at L5); two single-target hits followed by a field-wiping AoE that reliably clears escort troops.

conquest.name: Falling Swallow
conquest.effect: Deals Attack x140% and reduces the target's Attack Speed by 50% for 2s (values at L5).

conquest.name: Twin Fangs
conquest.effect: Increases her Attack (+24% at L5).

expedition.name: On Guard
expedition.effect: Increases all Squads' total Lethality (+25% at L5) — IDENTICAL to Chenko's Stand of Arms. Her signature joiner buff for Bear Hunt and offensive PvP rallies.

expedition.name: Well-Traveled
expedition.effect: Increases Research Speed (+15% at L5, additive). An elite early-game growth buff that accelerates account tech.

details.strategy: One of the best F2P heroes in the game — three strong roles in one farmable package. GROWTH: Well-Traveled gives +15% (additive) Research Speed, a top early-game priority for account tech. JOINER: On Guard is a 25% army lethality buff identical to Chenko's, so she is a staple for Bear Hunt/PvP rallies; remember lethality stacks additively with Chenko/Yeonwoo but MULTIPLICATIVELY with Amane's Tri-Phalanx attack buff, so mix her with Amane for optimal rally damage. COMBAT: In Conquest/Arena she is a premier AoE dealer, better than Diana at full stars — Petalbloom's 3-wave finisher is a reliable AoE field-wipe, Falling Swallow adds a -50% attack-speed debuff, and Twin Fangs gives +24% attack, letting her outclass every other starter purple in field damage. She loses to Chenko only in solo march combat (Chenko has 2 combat skills, Yeonwoo has 1). Play her backline for uptime; cornerstone of F2P formations for the first few generations.
details.investment: Top priority for epic/general shards — reach at least 4 stars to max her abilities. She needs 30 FEWER shards to unlock than Chenko while giving more total utility (research + lethality + AoE), so prioritize her over Chenko for shard efficiency (build Chenko too for the solo-march edge and dual joiners).
details.story: A meticulous, sharp-eyed swordswoman whose extensive travels give her a unique perspective; stay alert around her whether friend or foe.

entries.name: Jabel
entries.summary: Everyone's favorite early game cavalry and the only true F2P mythic hero in Generation 1.

details.role_focus: Best early-game cavalry: top rally leader + premier AoE/CC damage dealer; the only true F2P Mythic of Gen 1.

conquest.name: Gallant Throw
conquest.effect: Throws a spear that pierces defenses for Attack x252% AoE damage and pins targets for 1.5s (values at L5). Her signature: big AoE + crowd control that disrupts enemy formations.

conquest.name: Brave the Storm
conquest.effect: Deals Attack x210% single-target damage (at L5). NOT a passive buff — a specialized auto-attack with a built-in damage boost on its own cooldown.

conquest.name: Persistence
conquest.effect: Increases her Attack Speed (+60% at L5) when her Health is below 50%. Do NOT deliberately expose her to trigger it — her AoE uptime matters more than this.

expedition.name: Rally Flag
expedition.effect: 40% chance to reduce damage taken by 50% for all squads (at L5). CAUTION: as a %-chance skill it does NOT stack when multiple players send Jabel as a joiner, making her inferior to health-stacking Gordon for coordinated garrisons.

expedition.name: Hero's Domain
expedition.effect: Grants all squads a 50% chance to deal 50% more damage when attacking (at L5).

expedition.name: Youthful Rage
expedition.effect: Increases Squads' Lethality (+25% at L5). Same lethality family as Chenko/Yeonwoo (additive with them, multiplicative with Amane's attack buff).

exclusive_gear.name: Greaves of Faith

gear_skills.name: Crimson Spirit
gear_skills.effect: Increases her damage dealt (+30% at Lv9).

gear_skills.name: Divine Strength
gear_skills.effect: Increases Defender Troops' Lethality (+15% at Lv10). This defensive lethality bonus is MULTIPLICATIVE.

exclusive_gear.note: Exclusive gear is hero-specific (unlike normal portable hero gear). Low-spenders should be careful not to over-invest widgets here since they likely won't lead garrison defense anyway.

details.strategy: Foundational Mythic cavalry and a must-build for everyone (F2P and spenders) — the only true F2P Mythic of Gen 1, with easily farmed shards (Intel Missions, recruitment) and no competing Mythic cavalry. Best used as an early RALLY LEADER (three combat skills: Hero's Domain 50%/50% damage proc + Youthful Rage 25% lethality) and as a premier Conquest/Arena AoE + crowd-control dealer via Gallant Throw (pins for 1.5s). Note her Mythic base stats are higher than purples (+200.16% troop atk/def vs +140.11%; 22,200 hero health). CAUTION as a joiner: Rally Flag is %-chance-based and does NOT stack across multiple Jabels, so she is worse than Gordon for coordinated defensive garrisons. Position her to avoid being the enemy's focus so she can cycle her AoE in peace. Staple in top formations through the first three hero generations.
details.investment: Must-build for all players. Easy to bring to full strength versus Gen 2's Hilde and the slow shard drip of Gen 3's Petra, so she stays viable across multiple generations. Prioritize her combat/rally build; don't over-invest exclusive-gear widgets if you won't be leading garrison defense. Competes in Arena meta alongside Amadeus and Marlin.
details.story: Sole survivor of a bandit attack that destroyed her village; became a red-armored paladin whose motto is 'Never fear darkness. Fear only the despair of the faithless.'

entries.name: Saul
entries.summary: Early game growth hero with a surprising resurgence in Generation 4.

acquisition: Hall of Heroes tickets (buyable with gems)
details.role_focus: Elite growth (construction) + PvP joiner; strong early combat archer with the highest base attack at launch.

conquest.name: Rapid Fire
conquest.effect: Multiple hits of Attack x75% each and stuns the target for 2s (at L5). Signature: area damage + a crucial stun to interrupt enemy heroes.

conquest.name: Final Prayer
conquest.effect: When Health is below 50%, his Defense increases (+150% at L5). Rarely enough to make him a real tank due to his small health pool.

conquest.name: Superior Techniques
conquest.effect: Increases his Attack Speed (+30% at L5) — lets him burn through enemy front lines quickly.

expedition.name: Taskforce Training
expedition.effect: Increases all Squads' Defense by 10% and Health by 15% (at L5). This is his ACTUAL joiner skill and is excellent in PvP: it splits two DIFFERENT skillcodes, boosting the multiplicative relationships with other heroes' abilities present in the rally.

expedition.name: Resourceful
expedition.effect: Increases Construction Speed by 15% AND reduces Construction Costs by 15% (at L5). One of the best early growth skills — compounds by unlocking growth bonuses faster. Value dips very late game when Truegold/Tempered Truegold (not reduced by this) becomes the bottleneck instead of build time.

expedition.name: Positional Battler
expedition.effect: Increases Squads' Lethality (+25% at L5). Same lethality family as Chenko/Yeonwoo, BUT it sits in the THIRD skill slot, so he cannot contribute it as a rally joiner (only the first expedition skill applies when joining).

exclusive_gear.name: Rabbitgear Cannon

gear_skills.name: Fearless Advance
gear_skills.effect: Increases his Attack (+24% at Lv9).

gear_skills.name: Defend to Attack
gear_skills.effect: Increases Defender Troops' Attack (+15% at Lv10).

exclusive_gear.note: Hero-specific exclusive gear. Most players should avoid pouring rare widgets into it — Gen 1 is short and Saul is outclassed on offense by Gen 2 and on defense by Gen 3; exception is top spenders maximizing Gen 1 combat or planning his Gen 4-6 60/40 garrison-lead resurgence.

details.strategy: A Mythic archer whose headline value is GROWTH: Resourceful (-15% construction time AND -15% cost) is one of the best early skills — build him to ~2-3 stars early to raise it, since faster town-building compounds into more growth bonuses. As a JOINER his real contribution is Taskforce Training (+10% def / +15% health) which splits two different skillcodes for strong multiplicative synergy in PvP rallies; his 25% lethality (Positional Battler) is wasted for joining because it's in the third slot. In COMBAT he has the highest base attack of any launch hero: Rapid Fire (AoE + 2s stun) plus Superior Techniques (+30% atk speed) make him a top Gen 1 Conquest/Arena damage dealer, though his small health pool means backline placement (Final Prayer's defense boost rarely saves him as a tank). Part of top Gen 1 teams; edged out on offense in Gen 2 (Marlin) but enjoys a resurgence in Gen 4-6 as the 60/40 garrison-lead meta becomes viable.
details.investment: Somewhat F2P-friendly but F2P can't fully build him from gems in Gen 1's short window; prioritize a few stars early purely for Resourceful's growth. NOTE acquisition quirk: Saul is NOT in the Gold Key pool, but unlike Helga/Amadeus he can be built via Hall of Heroes tickets (buyable in limited quantities with gems) — an alternative to orange shards. Don't over-invest widgets unless you are a top spender or targeting his Gen 4-6 comeback.
details.story: An unnervingly grinning logistics genius who delivers every project on time and under budget; something drives him to work faster and harder, and few dare ask why.

entries.name: Helga
entries.summary: Short-term pay-to-win hero with minor enduring value via global troop stat bonus; second-best-in-slot infantry Bear Hunt leader. Appears in the first-purchase promo.

details.role_focus: P2W early frontline tank + #2 infantry Bear Hunt rally lead (behind Amadeus); permanent global attack/defense talent.

conquest.name: Antler Assault
conquest.effect: Antler charge dealing Attack x224% AoE damage, knocking targets back and stunning them for 1s (at L5). The premier launch tactical move — disrupts the enemy front line and its timing often coincides with enemy ultimates, causing them to fail.

conquest.name: Spear Charge
conquest.effect: Deals Attack x210% single-target damage (at L5).

conquest.name: Fury
conquest.effect: When taking damage, 10% chance to increase Attack by 12% for 3s, stacking up to 5 times (values at L5).

expedition.name: Oath of Guardian
expedition.effect: 40% chance to reduce damage taken by 50% for all squads (at L5). CAUTION: %-chance skill that does NOT stack across multiple joiners with similarly-coded abilities, so she is suboptimal for rally joining vs stat-stackers like Gordon.

expedition.name: Echoes of Valhalla
expedition.effect: Increases the total Squads' Attack (+25% at L5). Attack family — multiplicative with lethality buffs.

expedition.name: Nature's Balance
expedition.effect: Increases the total Squads' Lethality (+25% at L5). Lethality family. Having BOTH a 25% attack and a 25% lethality buff is why she is an elite rally lead (they multiply together).

talent.name: Power of the Deer
talent.effect: Account-wide passive: bolsters ALL deployed soldiers' Attack and Defense by up to 10% (2/4/6/8/10% by level) even when Helga is absent from the march. Scales with her star level — this permanent global bonus is her most durable long-term value for spenders.

exclusive_gear.name: Bands of Tyre

gear_skills.name: Valiant Fury
gear_skills.effect: Increases her damage dealt (+30% at Lv9).

gear_skills.name: Zeal
gear_skills.effect: Increases Rally Troops' Lethality (+15% at Lv10). A damage-dealing offensive widget (multiplicative) — she and Amadeus are the ONLY infantry heroes with one, which sustains her Bear Hunt rally-lead value for generations.

exclusive_gear.note: Higher power (247,500) than Jabel/Saul gear (225,000) and higher expedition stats (+55.50% vs +50%), reflecting her P2W tier.

details.strategy: A pay-to-win burst hero: dominant for the first ~40 days, then a short window before spenders outgrow her. As a RALLY LEAD she beats Howard by bringing 3 combat skills (vs his 2) with both a 25% attack (Echoes of Valhalla) AND 25% lethality (Nature's Balance) that multiply together; but as a JOINER she is suboptimal because Oath of Guardian is %-chance and doesn't stack (Gordon's health is better). In COMBAT she is the launch 'whale meta' definer: Antler Assault (AoE + knockback + 1s stun) is the best early tactical move and can outright skip enemy ultimates, and her base health/attack tower over any purple (36,630 hero health), making her a meat-shield/damage hybrid, especially once Valiant Fury (+30% damage widget) unlocks. Play her front row with Howard, ideally opposite an enemy whose signature you want to disrupt. Falls off early in Gen 2-3 as defense stat-creep and specialized tanks outclass her hybrid design.
details.investment: Pack-purchase only (P2W) and NOT obtainable via Gold Keys or general shards — her shards come only from packs. A cheaper Amadeus alternative for spenders OK with an earlier drop-off. Two lasting advantages beyond her short combat prime: (1) Power of the Deer's permanent global +attack/+defense, and (2) she is the only infantry besides Amadeus with an offensive (multiplicative) widget, so non-Amadeus spenders can keep using her as a Bear Hunt rally lead for generations (with 2 offensive abilities vs Amadeus's 3).
details.story: A graceful, soft-spoken noblewoman who becomes a terrifying Valkyrie in battle with her long lance; adventurer Quinn repeatedly (and unsuccessfully) courts her and vows to prove who is stronger.

entries.name: Amadeus
entries.summary: Wildly pay-to-win hero with permanent global troop stat bonus, unique Bear Hunt kit, and offensive rally + Conquest dominance for ~4 generations. The definitive Gen 1 whale hero.

details.role_focus: Undisputed #1 infantry Bear Hunt rally lead (unchallenged for all generations so far); Conquest/Arena melee DPS+tank hybrid; permanent global lethality/health talent.

conquest.name: Combo Slash
conquest.effect: Casts enemies in the target area upward, followed by three powerful slashes each dealing Attack x224% damage (at L5). Primary AoE nuke.

conquest.name: Arcane Swordship
conquest.effect: Releases a burst of arcane energy with each sword slash, dealing Attack x23% damage to frontal foes (at L5).

conquest.name: Onslaught
conquest.effect: Increases Attack by 48% while Health is above 50% (at L5). This is why he is played in the BACKLINE (not the default infantry front row) — to keep his health above the threshold and sustain the buff.

expedition.name: Battle Ready
expedition.effect: Increases the total Squads' Lethality by 25% (at L5). Identical to Chenko's and Yeonwoo's lethality buff — a top joiner contribution, but he is almost always run as rally LEAD instead.

expedition.name: Way of the Blade
expedition.effect: Increases the total Squads' Attack by 25% (at L5). Attack family — multiplies with the lethality buff.

expedition.name: Unrighteous Strike
expedition.effect: 40% chance to increase damage dealt by 50% for all squads (at L5). Third offensive rally skill — no infantry hero in ANY generation released has 3 offensive damage skills like him.

talent.name: Born Leader
talent.effect: Account-wide passive: boosts Lethality AND Health of ALL deployed soldiers by up to 15% even when Amadeus is absent from the march (3/6/9/12/15% by star level). Stronger than Helga's Power of the Deer (lethality+health vs attack+defense, 15% vs 10%).

exclusive_gear.name: Aegis of Fate

gear_skills.name: Double Parry
gear_skills.effect: Reduces damage taken by 30% (at Lv9). Turns him into a nearly unkillable meat-shield when combined with his huge base health.

gear_skills.name: Discernment
gear_skills.effect: Increases Rally Attack by 15% (at Lv10). A 4th offensive multiplicative widget bonus — the ONLY infantry offensive rally widget in the game, cementing his Bear Hunt rally-lead permanence.

exclusive_gear.note: Highest exclusive-gear power in the game so far (281,250 vs Helga 247,500, Jabel/Saul 225,000) and highest expedition stats (+62.50% vs Helga +55.50%), reflecting his top P2W tier.

details.strategy: The ultimate whale hero. As BEAR HUNT RALLY LEAD he is unchallenged by every hero generation released to date: he is the only infantry with an offensive widget (Discernment) AND 3 offensive damage skills (Battle Ready 25% lethality + Way of the Blade 25% attack + Unrighteous Strike 40%/50% proc), and because infantry are a low proportion of Bear formations, stat creep from newer heroes never offsets his multiplicative offensive stack. Helga is a distant second (only 2 offensive abilities). His 260.20% infantry attack/defense base contribution stays unchallenged until much later generations; the inflection point where a newer hero's raw stats overtake his offensive-widget multiplier is roughly Gen 5's Long Fei (and varies per player based on pets/gear/charms). In CONQUEST/ARENA he is a melee DPS+tank hybrid (arguably the only viable one): Combo Slash + Arcane Swordship for AoE damage, played in the BACKLINE to keep Onslaught's +48% attack active (health >50%), with Double Parry (-30% damage) making him a meat-shield that outlasts nearly everyone. He stays S-tier formation damage into Gen 4/5, and is arena backline until then. Displaced only on defensive GARRISON by Zoe (Gen 2) because he lacks a defensive widget type.
details.investment: Top P2W priority for spenders — pack-purchase only, NOT obtainable via Gold Keys or general/orange shards (same exception as Helga; unlike Saul, no Hall of Heroes ticket path either). The developers deliberately engineered his longevity to match his price tag. His two permanent advantages survive his combat prime: (1) Born Leader's global +15% lethality/health to all troops forever, and (2) the only infantry offensive rally widget, keeping him the Bear Hunt rally lead essentially indefinitely. If you only buy one Gen 1 P2W hero, it is Amadeus over Helga.
details.story: An incredible swordsman of both speed and power — his twin swords are said to be fast enough to split a river in two. Quiet and rough on the outside but with a heart of gold; his adoptive father, an outlaw, brought him along on adventures, and though his advice was unreliable his swordsmanship never let the League down.

entries.name: Zoe
entries.summary: F2P infantry staple from Generation 2 that excels at garrison defense with a quirky Bear Hunt expedition ability. First mythic infantry available to free-to-play players.

details.role_focus: Best-in-slot garrison DEFENSE lead (beats even Amadeus when fully built); Gen 2/3 arena front-row tank; F2P's first mythic infantry.

conquest.name: Shield Strike
conquest.effect: Enwebs foes dealing Attack x84% damage every 0.5s AND amplifies damage taken by the target by 30% for 2s (values at L5). The damage-taken debuff lets backline dealers melt the enemy front line.

conquest.name: Agony Rush
conquest.effect: Immediately regains 40% of max Health when under 50% Health (at L5). Once per battle. Greatly extends her tank uptime.

conquest.name: Holy Might
conquest.effect: Boosts your heroes' Attack Speed by 7% (at L5). Team-wide speed buff.

expedition.name: Sundering Wound
expedition.effect: Squads' attacks gain a 20% chance to inflict Sunder, dealing 40% damage per turn for 3 turns (at L5). WARNING: does NOT work in Bear Hunt (combat-coding quirk) and does NOT stack across joiners — never send her as a Bear joiner for this. Being the 1st expedition skill, it is also the one that counts for joining, so her joiner value is wasted on Bear.

expedition.name: Charisma
expedition.effect: Increases the total Squads' Attack by 25% (at L5). Flat attack buff — multiplies with lethality buffs.

expedition.name: Infinite Arsenal
expedition.effect: Squads' attacks gain a 50% chance to amplify enemy squads' damage taken by 50% (at L5). High-upside probability skill.

exclusive_gear.name: The Unrighteous

gear_skills.name: Death Or Glory
gear_skills.effect: Gains 24% increased Attack until end of battle once Agony Rush triggers (at Lv9).

gear_skills.name: Dark Lady
gear_skills.effect: Increases Defender Squads' Attack by 15% (at Lv10). A DEFENSIVE-rally (garrison) multiplicative widget — this is why she surpasses Amadeus on garrison defense despite his stronger base kit: he lacks a defensive widget.

exclusive_gear.note: Her widget aligns to DEFENSIVE rallies (garrison), the opposite of Amadeus's offensive Discernment — she wins on defense, he wins on offense.

details.strategy: The F2P mythic-infantry answer for players without Helga/Amadeus, and the definitive Gen 2 garrison DEFENSE lead — her Dark Lady widget (+15% defender attack, multiplicative) plus Gen 2 stats let her surpass even a fully-built Amadeus on defensive garrison. In CONQUEST/ARENA she is the standout Gen 2 front-row tank: first hero to exceed the 2,220 base defense (2,664) with a huge 39,960 health, Shield Strike amplifies enemy damage taken by 30% (helps backline melt the enemy front), and Agony Rush gives a one-time 40% heal under half health. Her team-wide +7% attack speed (Holy Might) makes her a 'no regrets' Gen 2 arena investment. Usually front row, but niche arena formations place her back-right to time her damage-taken debuff with Marlin's AoE, extending her top-team relevance into Gen 3. As a Bear Hunt LEAD she is only decent (2 damage skills but wrong widget type, and Sundering Wound is dead on Bear); NEVER a Bear joiner (Sundering Wound doesn't work on Bear and doesn't stack).
details.investment: A 'no regrets' F2P investment obtained from the Gen 2 Hero Roulette wheel — no spending required. Priority for any player who skipped the Gen 1 P2W heroes and needs a mythic infantry, especially for garrison defense where she is actually best-in-slot over Amadeus. Later added to the Gold Key Epic Recruitment pool when the player reaches Generation 4 (alongside Marlin and Hilde). Avoid using her as a Bear joiner.
details.story: Zoe expresses her emotions through her magical hair rather than words: black signals patience as she waits to strike, yellow her exhilaration as the hunt begins. According to Amadeus, her hair has reflected her mood since childhood; she channels every cell of her body to chase and tear apart her prey.

entries.name: Hilde
entries.summary: Defensive cavalry that slightly improves on Jabel but is much harder to build. The game's first true support/healer hero.

details.role_focus: Garrison DEFENSE lead (slight upgrade over Jabel); first real Conquest/Arena healer+support; useful PvP joiner via unique skillcode mix.

conquest.name: Rejuvenating Plea
conquest.effect: Immediately restores Health equal to Attack x280% to ALL five friendly heroes (at L5). Triggers ~6s into combat, letting it neutralize enemy ultimate damage and extend frontline uptime. Boosted +70% by the Holy Invocation gear skill.

conquest.name: Redeemer
conquest.effect: Immediately restores Health equal to Attack x140% to the single weakest friendly hero (at L5).

conquest.name: Intimidation
conquest.effect: Disables (stuns) the enemy target for 1s while dealing Attack x196% damage (at L5). Crowd control to disrupt backline dealers or interrupt enemy hero abilities.

expedition.name: Noble Path
expedition.effect: Increases the total Squads' Attack by 15% and Defense by 10% (at L5). Combined attack+defense passive.

expedition.name: Elixir of Strength
expedition.effect: Grants all squads' attack a 25% chance of dealing 200% damage (at L5).

expedition.name: Trial by Fire
expedition.effect: 40% chance to reduce damage taken by 50% for all squads (at L5). %-chance survivability proc (doesn't stack across joiners).

exclusive_gear.name: Revelation

gear_skills.name: Holy Invocation
gear_skills.effect: Increases her healing effects by 70% (at Lv9). Massively amplifies Rejuvenating Plea/Redeemer.

gear_skills.name: Fortitude
gear_skills.effect: Increases Defender Squads' Health by 15% (at Lv10). A DEFENSIVE-rally (garrison) widget — this is what makes her a slight garrison upgrade over Jabel.

exclusive_gear.note: Defensive widget (like Zoe's Dark Lady) aligns her to garrison defense. Her expedition value is ~25% expected — same as Jabel's but on a different skillcode mix, so the real gain over Jabel is just Gen 2 cavalry stats.

details.strategy: Meant as Kingshot's improvement over Jabel but only slightly so: her expedition kit nets the same ~25% expected value as Jabel on a different skillcode combination, so most of her edge is just the Gen 2 cavalry stat bump. Because she's much harder to build, F2P players often skip her. For spenders she is a slight GARRISON DEFENSE upgrade over Jabel (Fortitude defensive widget) and a useful PvP joiner thanks to her unique skillcode mix; she can even help as a Bear joiner if your alliance lacks a 15%+ attack alternative, but never let her bump out a hero bringing a 25% bonus. In CONQUEST/ARENA she is the game's FIRST impactful support/healer: Rejuvenating Plea heals all 5 heroes for 280% of her attack (+70% with Holy Invocation) ~6s in, neutralizing enemy ultimates and extending frontline uptime, while Intimidation adds a 1s stun for crowd control. Paired with tanks like Zoe and Amadeus she anchors the Gen 2 arena meta, but the Gen 3 defensive stat creep pushes her out quickly (lingers in one top formation into Gen 3, gone from top teams by Gen 4).
details.investment: Featured Hero acquisition but MUCH harder to build than Jabel, so F2P players commonly skip her despite her strong kit. Best justified for spenders leading garrison defense or wanting a Gen 2 arena healer/support. Added to the Gold Key Epic Recruitment pool at Generation 4 (with Zoe and Marlin). If you already have a well-built Jabel, the upgrade is marginal — weigh the heavy build cost.
details.story: Born into a noble family and sent to a church for her education, Hilde found her happiest childhood there, bringing light to the austere lives of the priests. At fourteen she was struck by a hereditary eye disease that inevitably takes the patient's sight — 'the gods took her sight in exchange for perception' — blindness inescapable unless a miracle happened.

entries.name: Marlin
entries.summary: Amazing Bear Hunt and Arena damage-dealing specialist. The first true offensive rally archer available to players, and best-in-slot offensive rally lead in Gen 2.

details.role_focus: Best-in-slot OFFENSIVE rally lead (Gen 2, incl. Bear Hunt); dominant Arena/Conquest AoE damage dealer + crowd controller.

conquest.name: Tidal Rush
conquest.effect: Unleashes a pulse dealing 280% AoE damage to the ENTIRE enemy field and immobilizing (stuns) them for 1.5s (at L5). Uses the highest attack stat in Gen 2; the stun can interrupt enemy ultimates.

conquest.name: Fermented Blow
conquest.effect: Deals Attack x70% AoE damage (at L5).

conquest.name: Lucky Hit
conquest.effect: Stuns targets after every 5 strikes (at L5; fewer strikes needed at higher levels: 8/7/6/5/5).

expedition.name: Wild Card
expedition.effect: 40% chance to increase damage dealt by 50% for all squads (at L5). This is his 1st-position (joiner-counting) skill but its effective value is ~20% (below the 25% benchmark) and it does NOT stack across joiners — so his max value is as a rally LEAD, not a joiner.

expedition.name: Rumhead
expedition.effect: 20% chance on attack to reduce the total Enemy Squads' Lethality by 50% for 2 turns (at L5). A lethality DEBUFF on the enemy.

expedition.name: Dynamo
expedition.effect: Grants squads' attack a 50% chance of increasing damage dealt by 50% (at L5).

exclusive_gear.name: Mistweaver

gear_skills.name: Servant of Wine
gear_skills.effect: Heals your weakest hero by Attack x15% with each basic attack (at Lv9). Incidental team sustain from his back-left safety slot.

gear_skills.name: Admiral of the Line
gear_skills.effect: Increases Rally Squads' Lethality by 15% (at Lv10). An OFFENSIVE-rally multiplicative widget — the critical piece that makes him best-in-slot for offensive rallies.

exclusive_gear.note: Offensive widget (Admiral of the Line, like Amadeus's Discernment) — the opposite of the defensive widgets on Zoe/Hilde. This is what makes him the go-to offensive archer rally lead.

details.strategy: The first true offensive rally ARCHER and best-in-slot Gen 2 offensive rally lead thanks to Dynamo + Wild Card damage boosts, Rumhead's enemy lethality debuff, and his offensive Admiral of the Line widget (+15% rally lethality, multiplicative). Transitioning your Bear Hunt rally lead to him significantly raises your Bear score, making him a compelling F2P/low-spend value over Saul. But because Wild Card (his joiner-counting 1st skill) is only ~20% effective and doesn't stack, his ceiling is as LEAD, not joiner; F2P players eventually replace him with Gen 4's Rosa (Hero Roulette). In CONQUEST/ARENA he is a dominant AoE disruptor: Tidal Rush hits the whole enemy field for 280% with a 1.5s stun (highest Gen 2 attack, 3,235), interrupting ultimates. Position him BACK-LEFT safety slot to maximize uptime (also gives incidental heals via Servant of Wine). Exceptional synergy with Zoe: place her backline/back-right so her Shield Strike damage-taken debuff lands just before his AoE volleys, melting the enemy front row. Stays Arena-relevant until near the end of Gen 4, with or without Zoe.
details.investment: Obtained from the Hall of Heroes (Gen 2). Strong return on investment for F2P/low-spend players, especially to upgrade Bear Hunt scoring — generally a better value pick than Saul for offensive archer rally lead. Added to the Gold Key Epic Recruitment pool at Generation 4 (with Zoe and Hilde). Build him to LEAD rallies, not to join (Wild Card doesn't stack). His replacement window opens with Rosa in Gen 4.
details.story: A large, battered ship from the north appears in town, its hull dented and a massive tear from center to bow, guarded by a gruff old man in a black tricorn and red woolen coat. The well-traveled Quinn eventually recognizes it as 'The Santiago,' missing for thirty years, and the drunken old captain as Marlin — once one of the Four Great Captains.

entries.name: Eric
entries.summary: Amazing Arena tank and short-lived best-in-slot garrison infantry leader (Gen 3). Big frontline-tanking step up thanks to the Gen 3 defense stat jump.

details.role_focus: Best-in-slot infantry GARRISON lead in Gen 3 (until Alcar in Gen 4); elite Arena front-line tank; niche but durable PvP joiner via a unique low-chance skillcode.

conquest.name: Ground Shock
conquest.effect: Smashes his blessed hammer for Attack x168% damage to the target ahead while reducing targets' Attack Speed by 50% for 4s (at L5). Strong crowd control.

conquest.name: Veterancy
conquest.effect: Attacks against Eric have a 16% chance to increase Defense by 20% for 2s, stacking up to 5 times (values at L5). Scaling tankiness under fire.

conquest.name: Hammer of Justice
conquest.effect: Casts his warhammer into the ground for Attack x112% damage in a fan-shaped arc with a 30% chance to stun targets for 1s (at L5).

expedition.name: Holy Warrior
expedition.effect: Reduces total Enemy Squads' Attack by 20% (at L5). UNIQUE skillcode with NO %-chance — an enemy-attack debuff that frequently lands in joiner formations where it MULTIPLIES with the more common hero skills, preserving its value long-term despite the 20% cap.

expedition.name: Conviction
expedition.effect: Reduces Squads' Damage Taken by 20% (at L5). Army-wide damage reduction (garrison value).

expedition.name: Exhortation
expedition.effect: Increases total Squads' Health by 25% (at L5). Army-wide health.

exclusive_gear.name: Anvil of Truth

gear_skills.name: Blessed Hammer
gear_skills.effect: Increases his damage by 30% (at Lv9). Feels like a design mismatch for a pure tank role.

gear_skills.name: Vanguard
gear_skills.effect: Increases Defender Squad Defense by 15% (at Lv10). A DEFENSIVE-rally (garrison) multiplicative widget — the piece that makes him the Gen 3 best-in-slot garrison lead.

exclusive_gear.note: Gen 3 gear power jumps to 315,000 (vs Gen 2 heroes' 270,000) and expedition stats to +70% (vs +60%), reflecting the Gen 3 stat increase. Defensive widget (Vanguard) like Zoe/Hilde.

details.strategy: Designed as a defensive rally leader; since PvP is fought symmetrically on offense and defense, the defense-flavored kit is largely cosmetic there. His standout expedition trick is Holy Warrior: a 20% enemy-attack reduction on a UNIQUE non-%-chance skillcode, so it lands in rally JOINER formations and MULTIPLIES with the common hero skills — that high chance of a multiplicative relationship offsets the 20% cap and keeps him relevant as a joiner into later generations. For GARRISON leading, Conviction (-20% damage taken) + Exhortation (+25% health) + his Vanguard defensive widget (+15% defense) plus higher base infantry stats than Zoe make him the Gen 3 best-in-slot garrison holder for castle battles / Swordland Showdown — but Gen 4's Alcar (superior defensive-widget infantry) cuts his reign short, so top competitive players build him while low-spenders stick with 'good enough' Zoe. In CONQUEST/ARENA he is an elite front-line tank: Gen 3 is the first generation to reliably get defense increases, giving him a massive +50% base defense over the old baseline (3,330 defense, 49,950 health). Ground Shock (-50% enemy attack speed 4s), Veterancy (stacking defense when hit), and Hammer of Justice (AoE 1s stun) make him a staple alongside Zoe/Amadeus; stays in top Arena formations through Gen 4 and much of Gen 5 while players slow-build Long Fei to replace him.
details.investment: Obtained from the Hall of Heroes (Gen 3). A top-competitive-player build for Gen 3 garrison holding and Arena tanking; lower spenders can skip since Zoe is 'good enough' and Alcar (Gen 4) soon dethrones him on garrison. His unique Holy Warrior joiner code gives lasting PvP value even after his garrison prime. Added to the Gold Key Epic Recruitment pool at Generation 5 (with Petra and Jaeger).
details.story: Once called 'The Pious One' for his unshakable willingness to use the paladin's hammer of correction against anyone who slandered or harmed the Ecclesia. A firm believer that 'whoever is not absolutely loyal to us is against us,' he gladly accepted any task assigned, even the unpleasant business of forced tithing.

entries.name: Jaeger
entries.summary: Elite garrison archer hero and Arena crowd-control specialist. Best-in-slot archer garrison leader in Gen 3, with the highest base attack of all Gen 3 heroes.

details.role_focus: Best-in-slot archer GARRISON lead in Gen 3 (until Vivian in Gen 5); dominant Arena back-row crowd-control disruptor; avoid as joiner.

conquest.name: Fatal Attraction
conquest.effect: Deals Attack x224% damage to enemies in the target area and stuns them for 2s (at L5). Big AoE stun (siren's song).

conquest.name: Game of Chance
conquest.effect: Gamble: if successful deals Attack x300% damage, OTHERWISE restores the target's Health equal to Attack x50% (at L5). The downside (healing the enemy) is his one weakness, but his other skills more than compensate.

conquest.name: Rumormonger
conquest.effect: Field-wide debuff increasing Enemy Damage Taken by 30% for 3s (at L5). Amplifies your whole formation's damage.

expedition.name: The Tempest
expedition.effect: 20% chance to increase Squads' damage dealt by 40% for 3 turns (at L5). His 1st/priority expedition skill; effective value ~24% (just under the 25% benchmark) AND %-chance so it doesn't stack across joiners — avoid sending him as a joiner.

expedition.name: The Resistance
expedition.effect: 20% chance on attack to reduce the total Enemy Squads' Lethality by 50% for 2 turns (at L5). Effective value ~20% (below benchmark).

expedition.name: The Celebration
expedition.effect: Increases total Squads' Health by 25% (at L5). Army-wide health for garrison.

exclusive_gear.name: Wanderwail

gear_skills.name: Sound of Silence
gear_skills.effect: Silences the target, preventing it from using skills for up to 5s (skills already cast are unaffected) while dealing damage (silence duration 1s/2s/3s/4s/5s by level). Elite tool for delaying/denying enemy ultimates.

gear_skills.name: Hymn to Survival
gear_skills.effect: Increases Defender Squads' Health by 15% (at Lv10). A DEFENSIVE-rally (garrison) multiplicative widget — the piece that makes him the Gen 3 best-in-slot archer garrison lead.

exclusive_gear.note: Gen 3 gear power 315,000 and +70% expedition stats (same tier as Eric). Defensive widget (Hymn to Survival) like Eric/Zoe/Hilde — the opposite of Marlin's offensive Admiral of the Line.

details.strategy: The Gen 3 mythic archer built as a premier defensive GARRISON leader: his defensive widget (Hymn to Survival, +15% defender health) plus a big archer stat jump over Saul make him best-in-slot archer garrison holder in Gen 3 — assuming an archer-heavy garrison, which is standard before 60/40 formations become meta. His expedition kit is otherwise mediocre for joining: The Tempest is ~24% and %-chance (doesn't stack) and The Resistance ~20%, so AVOID sending him as a joiner. He CAN lead Bear Hunt rallies off his high archer stats, but Marlin is better (Jaeger has only one damage skill and the wrong, defensive widget). In CONQUEST/ARENA he is a dominant back-row disruptor (bard archetype) with the HIGHEST base attack of all Gen 3 heroes (4,045): Fatal Attraction (AoE 2s stun) + gear's Sound of Silence (up to 5s skill lockout) let him delay/deny enemy ultimates, while Rumormonger (+30% enemy damage taken) amplifies your whole formation. Game of Chance can occasionally heal the enemy, but his other skills secure him a top-team Arena spot; garrison duty is later handed to Vivian in Gen 5.
details.investment: Featured Hero acquisition (Gen 3). Priority build for competitive players wanting a Gen 3 archer garrison lead or an Arena crowd-control/silence disruptor. Build him to LEAD garrison, not to join rallies (The Tempest doesn't stack). Replaced on garrison duty by Vivian in Gen 5. Added to the Gold Key Epic Recruitment pool at Generation 5 (with Eric and Petra).
details.story: Jaeger the travelling bard, a man of many talents whose singer-songwriter gift commands attention from governor and noble, rich and poor alike. Applause and requests to play follow him at every crossroads — 'by the time the song ended, so too did the enemy.'

entries.name: Petra
entries.summary: F2P-friendly Bear Hunt cavalry hero with 'hidden' skills. The only offensive cavalry in the first 4 generations and the best cavalry Bear rally lead until Gen 7 (Ava).

details.role_focus: Best-in-slot cavalry OFFENSIVE Bear Hunt rally lead through Gen 6; high-risk/high-reward random-kit Conquest carry; niche single-copy PvP joiner.

conquest.name: Dichotomy
conquest.effect: Throws a tarot card dealing Attack x378% damage and inflicting one of: -20% target Attack for 2s OR a 1.5s stun (at L5).

conquest.name: Change of Fate
conquest.effect: Curses an enemy for floating damage on a base of Attack x70%, with FINAL damage a random 5%-600% of that base (at L5). Extreme variance.

conquest.name: Turn Card
conquest.effect: Heals the friendly hero with the lowest % Health on a base of Attack x140%, with FINAL heal a random 5%-400% of that base (at L5).

expedition.name: Evil Eye
expedition.effect: Grants all Squads' Attack a 50% chance to curse the target, increasing its damage taken by 50% (at L5). KEY HIDDEN MECHANIC: it rolls on EVERY troop attack within a turn (not once per turn), giving an effective ~87.5% proc rate PER TURN — making it far stronger than its 50% description suggests. Does NOT stack across copies.

expedition.name: The Favor
expedition.effect: 50% chance to increase Squads' Attack by 50% (at L5).

expedition.name: The Shield
expedition.effect: 40% chance to reduce damage taken by 50% for all squads (at L5).

exclusive_gear.name: Fate's Writ

gear_skills.name: Weighted Deck
gear_skills.effect: Increases the upper AND lower limit of her fluctuating (random) skills by 150% (at Lv9). This is transformative: it raises the MINIMUM outcome of her gambling skills, turning her from a volatile gamble into a reliable carry.

gear_skills.name: Cosmic Eye
gear_skills.effect: Increases Rally Squad Attack by 15% (at Lv10). An OFFENSIVE-rally multiplicative widget — combined with Evil Eye, this is what makes her the top cavalry Bear rally lead.

exclusive_gear.note: The ONLY offensive-widget cavalry hero in the first 4 generations. Weighted Deck (raising the floor of her RNG skills) is unusually important for her — a rare case where widget investment fundamentally changes reliability, not just power.

details.strategy: A unique niche: the first truly OFFENSIVE cavalry hero across the first four generations, and — thanks to the hidden Evil Eye mechanic — the strongest cavalry Bear Hunt rally lead all the way up to Gen 7's Ava, even surpassing Gen 5's offensive cavalry Thrud (better move kit + the low infantry fraction in Bear formations blunts stat creep). This longevity makes her one of the best long-term F2P investments in the game. Evil Eye rolls per-attack (not per-turn) for a ~87.5% effective proc, massively amplifying enemy damage taken. CAUTION: Evil Eye doesn't stack, so she is not a great joiner — but sending exactly ONE copy in later-gen PvP formations (where she isn't the lead) adds this statistically superior joiner code. In CONQUEST/ARENA she is a high-variance gambler (Change of Fate 5-600% damage, Turn Card 5-400% heal, Dichotomy stun/attack-down); inconsistent for Arena without widget investment, but retriable Conquest stages turn her RNG into an ADVANTAGE (fish for lucky runs against stronger foes), and the Gen 3 defense jump lets her cover frontline in a pinch. Her exclusive gear's Weighted Deck (+150% to the floor/ceiling of her random skills) is the key that converts her from gamble to carry.
details.investment: F2P-friendly from the Gen 3 Hero Roulette wheel — no spending needed to acquire. One of the LONGEST-lasting investments available: best cavalry Bear rally lead through Gen 6, so orange shards / widgets spent on her pay off for many generations. F2P players should still weigh the substantial widget (Weighted Deck) investment needed for her Conquest/Arena consistency, though her Bear value comes mostly from Evil Eye + Cosmic Eye. Build her to LEAD Bear rallies; only ever send ONE copy as a joiner. Added to the Gold Key Epic Recruitment pool at Generation 5 (with Eric and Jaeger).
details.story: As a 14-year-old, Petra nearly bankrupted her local casino — 14 consecutive sixes and just getting warmed up. Amadeus sacrificed two rounds trying to spot the trick; the crowd cried cheating and 'Take her to the Governor!' until Marlin recognized the distinctive marker on her outfit: she was a royal fortune-teller. 'Her battle plan consisted of two steps: get lucky, then pretend it was skill.'

entries.name: Alcar
entries.summary: Unique Gen 4 hero that turns infantry into damage dealers and sets a new standard for Arena combat. Core enabler (with Margot) of the 60/40 formation and best Gen 4 garrison infantry.

details.role_focus: Best-in-slot infantry GARRISON lead (Gen 4); elite Arena front-line tank (highest defense/health in Gen 4); 60/40 formation enabler; can rival Amadeus on offensive rallies for lighter spenders.

conquest.name: Glorious Mark
conquest.effect: Enters an invulnerable state (can't move/cast, immune to control) and reduces Damage Taken by 70% for nearby friendly squads for 2s (at L5). Triggers ~5s into the match, perfectly neutralizing most enemy ultimates.

conquest.name: Boneshatter
conquest.effect: Spears a line of enemies for Attack x98% damage and increases Damage Taken by hit enemies by 20% for 2s (at L5).

conquest.name: Second Wind
conquest.effect: While Glorious Mark is active, restores Attack x42% Health every second for 5s (at L5). Big self-sustain.

expedition.name: Rescuing Hands
expedition.effect: Reduces Infantry AND Archer Damage Taken by 70% for 2 turns, every 5 turns (at L5). His priority expedition skill; NOTE the 5-turn cooldown and that it fails if all infantry are defeated.

expedition.name: Praetorian Will
expedition.effect: Increases Infantry Damage Dealt by 100% and Cavalry/Archer Damage Dealt by 10% (at L5). The signature 'infantry become damage dealers' skill that enables 60/40 formations.

expedition.name: Carpe Diem
expedition.effect: On attack, increases Infantry Damage Dealt by 60% and target Damage Taken by 25% for 1 turn (at L5).

exclusive_gear.name: Praetorian Guard

gear_skills.name: Flagbearer
gear_skills.effect: While Glorious Mark is active, increases friendly Squads' Attack by 42% for 2.5s (at Lv9). A huge team-wide offensive burst layered onto his defensive ultimate.

gear_skills.name: Vow of Honor
gear_skills.effect: Increases Defender Squads' Health by 15% (at Lv10). A DEFENSIVE-rally (garrison) multiplicative widget — combined with his kit, makes him the Gen 4 best-in-slot garrison holder.

exclusive_gear.note: Gen 4 gear power leaps to 416,250 (vs Gen 3's 315,000) with +92.50% expedition stats (vs +70%), a big Gen 4 power jump. Defensive widget (Vow of Honor) but his damage skills let a garrison of infantry actually deal damage.

details.strategy: A game-changing Gen 4 hero: his Praetorian Will (+100% infantry damage) and Carpe Diem turn infantry from pure tanks into real DAMAGE DEALERS, which (together with cavalry hero Margot) enables the powerful 60/40 formation meta. For GARRISON he is Gen 4 best-in-slot: Rescuing Hands (-70% infantry/archer damage taken, 5-turn cooldown, fails if infantry wiped) plus his Vow of Honor defensive widget make him the new standard for holding castle/turrets, dethroning Eric. As a Bear rally LEAD he is a step up from Eric (he buffs archers too, whereas Eric buffs none), though the low infantry fraction in Bear blunts it. Notably, due to stat creep and the high infantry share in PvP formations, Alcar can OUTPERFORM Amadeus on offensive marches for lighter spenders who lack the aggregate governor gear/charms/research stats needed to fully exploit Amadeus's offensive widget. In CONQUEST/ARENA he is the premier tank with the highest base defense (4,106) and health (61,604) of any Gen 4 hero — nearly DOUBLE Gen 2 heroes' defense: Glorious Mark gives a team-wide 70% damage reduction ~5s in (neutralizing ultimates) while making him invulnerable, Second Wind self-heals, and the gear's Flagbearer adds a +42% team attack burst during Glorious Mark. Best-in-slot Arena anchor through at least Gen 5.
details.investment: Featured Hero acquisition (Gen 4). A top-priority build: best Gen 4 garrison holder, 60/40 formation enabler, and an Arena anchor that lasts through at least Gen 5. Uniquely, he can be a better OFFENSIVE rally lead than Amadeus for players who scaled back spending (less aggregate multiplicative stats to feed Amadeus's widget). Pairs with Margot for the 60/40 meta. Added to the Gold Key Epic Recruitment pool at Generation 6.
details.story: Alcar was a member of the Praetorian Guard, holding the prestigious rank of 'Flagbearer' — reserved for the single best among all the Guard, a title of absolute strength and unwavering loyalty. 'Surrender is never an option! We do not retreat, we do not yield! ... This is loyalty to the Emperor, this is a vow of honor!'

entries.name: Rosa
entries.summary: F2P-friendly best-in-slot Bear Hunt rally leader (Gen 4, replacing Marlin) that underwhelms in Arena despite the highest Gen 4 base stats.

details.role_focus: Best-in-slot archer OFFENSIVE Bear Hunt rally lead in Gen 4 (upgrade over Marlin); highest Gen 4 base stats but a weak Arena kit (no AoE); NOT for 60/40 formations.

conquest.name: Battle Focus
conquest.effect: Clears all debuffs (control effects, etc.) for all squads and increases their Attack by 7% for a duration during which they are immune to debuffs (at L5). Her main Arena value: countering enemy crowd control.

conquest.name: Flutterfang
conquest.effect: Spins her fan blade for Attack x300% damage to enemies in its path (at L5). Marketed as line-piercing but usually acts single-target in Arena (targeting logic picks the closest enemy hero).

conquest.name: Swoon Chakra
conquest.effect: Reduces enemy squads' Attack Speed by 3% and healing effects by 60% (values at L5). Incidental utility.

expedition.name: Chaos Gambit
expedition.effect: 40% chance to increase all Squads' Damage Dealt by 50% (~20% effective at L5). IMPORTANT: coded internally as a LETHALITY UP skillcode (same as Chenko's first skill) despite the description — it stacks ADDITIVELY with similarly-coded skills AND, unusually for a %-chance skill, it DOES stack across multiple Rosa copies, so she can even be a viable Bear JOINER (expected value beats Hilde's +15% attack).

expedition.name: Rose of War
expedition.effect: Reduces damage dealt by 20% for all enemy squads (at L5). A 20%-capped enemy-attack debuff (below the 25% benchmark).
