expedition.name: Golden Rhythm
expedition.effect: Increases Archers' total Attack by 30% (at L5). ABOVE the 25% benchmark, but archer-only — so she buffs archers (the bulk of Bear formations) more than Marlin does, yet gives almost nothing to infantry/cavalry.

exclusive_gear.name: Aeolian

gear_skills.name: Night Reverie
gear_skills.effect: Upon casting Battle Focus, increases her Attack by 15% until end of battle (at Lv9).

gear_skills.name: Perihelion
gear_skills.effect: Increases Rally Squads' Lethality by 15% (at Lv10). An OFFENSIVE-rally multiplicative widget — the same as Marlin's Admiral of the Line, keeping her the offensive Bear rally lead.

exclusive_gear.note: Gen 4 gear power 416,250 with +92.50% expedition stats (same tier as Alcar). Offensive widget (Perihelion) like Marlin/Amadeus. Note her huge base attack (1,010 gear hero attack; 4,989 at 5-star max).

details.strategy: The Gen 4 F2P archer and best-in-slot BEAR HUNT rally lead, replacing Marlin: Golden Rhythm (+30% archer attack, above benchmark) buffs archers (the bulk of Bear formations) harder than Marlin, and her offensive Perihelion widget (+15% lethality) matches his. Because her Gen 4 base stats dwarf earlier generations, a fully-built Rosa beats a fully-built Marlin on Bear — a mandatory upgrade for most players. Rare bonus: Chaos Gambit is internally a lethality-up code that stacks additively AND across copies, so she's even a viable Bear JOINER (better expected value than Hilde), though in practice you lead with her until Yang (Gen 6), by which point +25% joiners are abundant and preferred. She is NOT good for Gen 4's 60/40 formations (no defensive widget to support Alcar/Margot, and archer-only buffs give little to infantry/cavalry) — use Saul or Jaeger there instead. In CONQUEST/ARENA she is the WEAKEST Gen 4 kit: highest base attack in the game for Gen 4 (4,989) but no AoE and no synergy to exploit it; Flutterfang usually hits single-target, Rose of War is only 20%. Her real utility is Battle Focus (clears debuffs + 5s debuff immunity field-wide) to counter heavy enemy CC. Do NOT give her the back-left safety slot — reserve that for an AoE dealer like Margot or Marlin. A short-lived Arena pick, but a 'no regrets' backline anchor for Gen 4 power thanks to easy building and Expedition value.
details.investment: Highly accessible from the Gen 4 Hero Roulette wheel (F2P). A mandatory Bear Hunt upgrade over Marlin for most players and an easy 'no regrets' build; her value is in Expedition (Bear), not Arena. Build her to LEAD Bear rallies (she can also join thanks to Chaos Gambit's stacking). Avoid using her in 60/40 formations or as a general offensive rally lead where archer share is low (Gen 4 PvP) — Saul/Jaeger are better there. Yang (Gen 6) eventually succeeds her as Bear rally lead.
details.story: An incredibly charming dancer whose eyes hold the depth of a starry sky. With an extraordinary sense of rhythm and passionate, bold movements — skillfully playing with light reflected from mirrors — she commands the tavern stage's spotlight and steals the audience's hearts before they realize it. 'Every step was part of the dance. Every blade in the fan was part of the lesson.'

entries.name: Margot
entries.summary: Strong enough to make cavalry part of the meta, with even stronger AoEs in Arena combat. Core enabler (with Alcar) of the Gen 4 60/40 formation and top Gen 4 garrison defense lead.

details.role_focus: Best-in-slot GARRISON defense lead (Gen 4, 60/40 enabler with Alcar); elite Arena AoE damage dealer; strong long-term +25% attack joiner (Bear & PvP).

conquest.name: Ambush
conquest.effect: Ambushes with bombs for Attack x420% AoE damage (at L5). One of the highest signature multipliers in the game (higher than Marlin/Jabel). Has an ~8s delay before first cast, which often dodges early-match enemy stuns so her ultimate reliably lands.

conquest.name: Parry
conquest.effect: 25% chance to parry, avoiding ALL damage from an enemy attack (at L5). Resilience that balances her offense.

conquest.name: Stiletto
conquest.effect: Head-gouges the enemy (heroes first) for Attack x140% damage and immobilizes them for 1.5s (at L5). Crowd control.

expedition.name: Warbringer
expedition.effect: Increases total Squads' Attack by 25% (at L5). A clean +25% attack (at benchmark) that STACKS — making her an excellent long-term joiner for Bear Hunt and PvP.

expedition.name: Subterfuge
expedition.effect: Grants all Squads a 20% chance of dodging Normal Attacks (at L5). UNIQUE mechanic: unlike other 20% damage-reduction codes (which just divide by 1.2), a dodge NULLIFIES all damage from that attack (effectively infinite defense for that hit). Especially strong in 60/40 (high native infantry/cavalry defense) and can shield archers from an early enemy cavalry strike.

expedition.name: Sleight Hand
expedition.effect: Margot's Cavalry have a 25% chance to perform an extra attack dealing 200% damage (at L5). Shreds enemy archers, especially when it combos with the native cavalry ability Ambusher.

exclusive_gear.name: Revel Fang

gear_skills.name: Indefensible
gear_skills.effect: 40% chance to launch a second attack with each Normal Attack, dealing Attack x45% damage (at Lv9). More follow-up burst.

gear_skills.name: Pugilist
gear_skills.effect: Increases Defender Squads' Lethality by 15% (at Lv10). A DEFENSIVE-rally (garrison) multiplicative widget — offsets the naturally lower infantry/cavalry damage in a 60/40 formation, cementing her as the Gen 4 garrison lead.

exclusive_gear.note: Gen 4 gear power 416,250 with +92.50% expedition stats (same tier as Alcar/Rosa). Defensive widget (Pugilist), but note it is a LETHALITY (offensive-stat) buff scoped to DEFENDERS — the garrison analog of an offensive widget.

details.strategy: The cavalry cornerstone of the Gen 4 meta. For GARRISON she is best-in-slot (with or without 60/40): Warbringer (+25% attack), the game-changing Subterfuge (20% chance to NULLIFY an attack's damage entirely, not just reduce it), Sleight Hand (cavalry extra 200% strikes that shred archers, combos with native Ambusher), and her Pugilist defensive-lethality widget make her the top garrison defense pick for KvK, Swordland, and rally-based PvP in Gen 4. Together with Alcar she enables the dominant 60/40 formation. Her Warbringer +25% is also a stacking, benchmark-level joiner buff, giving her lasting utility as a Bear Hunt / PvP JOINER. She is NOT a good Bear rally LEAD over Gen 3's Petra (doesn't buff archers enough and wrong widget type), but that's fine given her strength elsewhere. In CONQUEST/ARENA she is an elite AoE damage dealer with the 2nd-highest base attack in Gen 4 (4,106, even beating Gen 3 archer Jaeger via stat creep): Ambush's 420% AoE multiplier dwarfs older signatures (Marlin/Jabel), the ~8s cast delay dodges early stuns, and Parry (25% avoid all damage) plus Indefensible (40% follow-up) and Stiletto (1.5s immobilize) round her out — the best AoE specialist for competitive Arena since Gen 2.
details.investment: Obtained via Hall of Heroes ticket redemption (Gen 4; tickets buyable in limited quantities with gems, so buildable long-term like Saul). A top-priority build: best Gen 4 garrison defense lead, 60/40 enabler with Alcar, elite Arena AoE dealer, and a durable +25% stacking joiner for Bear/PvP. Pairs with Alcar for the 60/40 meta. Added to the Gold Key Epic Recruitment pool at Generation 6.
details.story: A painted-face performer whose comedic mime disarms her marks — 'Want to see some real magic?' — before a golden dagger finds the throat of a wealthy magnate mid-laugh. She wipes the paint away with bloodstained gloves, closing yet another scintillating 'performance.' 'The wall was imaginary. The casualties were not.'

entries.name: Long Fei
entries.summary: Gen 5 F2P infantry hero that does everything except Bear Hunt. The definitive F2P upgrade to Zoe, with enough stats to replace Amadeus on offense.

details.role_focus: Best-in-slot F2P infantry GARRISON defense lead (Gen 5, upgrades Zoe); strong Gen 5 Arena front-line tank via control-immunity + damage-to-heal; NOT a Bear rally lead/joiner.

conquest.name: Ambrosia
conquest.effect: Gains 120% Attack Speed and IMMUNITY to control effects for 4s (at L5). Enhanced by the Strong Brew gear skill to also heal from damage dealt.

conquest.name: Above And Beyond
conquest.effect: Reduces damage taken by 60% while under 50% Health (at L5). Kicks in when low to keep him alive.

conquest.name: Mountain Mover
conquest.effect: Gains 48% Attack while under 50% Health (at L5). Fuels his damage-to-heal loop when low (note: card art labels this 'Mounted Mover').

expedition.name: Mighty Paragon
expedition.effect: 40% chance to reduce damage taken by all squads by 50% (~20% effective at L5). His 1st/priority expedition skill.

expedition.name: Celestial Sustenance
expedition.effect: Increases total Squads' Defense by 25% (at L5). At-benchmark defensive buff.

expedition.name: Art of War
expedition.effect: 25% chance for squads' attacks to deal 200% damage (~25% effective at L5). His ONLY offensive skill. NOTE: the chance rolls INDEPENDENTLY per troop type (not one roll for all troops per turn), narrowing the outcome distribution and reducing catastrophically bad rolls — ideal for holding a garrison where you just need to survive.

exclusive_gear.name: Immortal's Flask

gear_skills.name: Strong Brew
gear_skills.effect: Extends Ambrosia by 1.5s and restores his health by 15% of damage dealt (at Lv9). The linchpin that makes his attack-to-heal survival loop work.

gear_skills.name: Strategic Strike
gear_skills.effect: Increases Defender Squads' Attack by 15% (at Lv10). A DEFENSIVE-rally (garrison) multiplicative widget — same alignment as Zoe's Dark Lady, so he is a garrison hero, not a Bear rally lead.

exclusive_gear.note: Gen 5 gear power jumps to 499,500 (vs Gen 4's 416,250) with +111.00% expedition stats (vs +92.50%). Defensive widget (Strategic Strike). His base infantry stats are now high enough to offset Amadeus's offensive widget in PvP rallies.

details.strategy: The Gen 5 F2P infantry, designed as a defensive GARRISON leader and the definitive upgrade to Zoe (2nd infantry on the Hero Roulette). His kit: Mighty Paragon (40%/-50% damage), Celestial Sustenance (+25% defense), and Art of War (25%/200% damage) whose per-troop-type independent rolls narrow variance — great for garrison holding. His Strategic Strike widget is DEFENSIVE (like Zoe), so he is NOT for Bear rally leading; and with only ONE offensive skill (vs 2 on Zoe/Alcar) he is a WORSE Bear rally lead than either and should NEVER be a joiner. His real value: compounded Gen 5 base infantry stats let him replace prior-gen heroes in PvP main marches, and are now high enough that his OFFENSIVE PvP rallies can offset Amadeus's widget — many whales drop Amadeus from offense by now (if they hadn't already with Alcar). In CONQUEST/ARENA he is an elite Gen 5 front-line tank built on control immunity + damage-based self-heal: Ambrosia (4s control immunity + attack speed, extended and made life-stealing by Strong Brew), plus Above And Beyond (-60% damage) and Mountain Mover (+48% attack) that trigger under 50% health. The attack-to-heal design makes him a 'win-more' tank that shines with a stat advantage but fades in later, higher-defense Arena generations. Still a 'no regrets' Gen 5 build, especially for multi-team modes like Mystic Trials and Tri Alliance Clash.
details.investment: Highly accessible from the Gen 5 Hero Roulette wheel (F2P) — the second infantry on the wheel and the clear upgrade over Zoe for garrison duty. Easy to build and valuable in multi-team content (Mystic Trials, Tri Alliance Clash). Build him for GARRISON/PvP main marches, never as a Bear rally lead or joiner (Zoe/Alcar are better Bear leads). His stats help retire Amadeus from offensive rallies for lighter spenders. Added to the Gold Key Epic Recruitment pool at Generation 7.
details.story: A coming-of-age exchange between a young man and an Elder: 'You already know what I'm going to decide, don't you?' — 'You're not here to make the choice. You've already made it. You're here to understand why you made it.' The youth sheepishly picks 'the red one,' saying it suits him. 'The harder the fight became, the healthier he looked.'

entries.name: Vivian
entries.summary: Gen 5 defensive archer with a unique Expedition/Arena move set that changes the usual enemy targeting sequence — an elite Bear/PvP joiner and premier back-row sniper.

details.role_focus: Elite Bear Hunt/PvP JOINER (unique priority skill code) and premier Gen 5 Conquest/Arena back-row sniper; strong non-60/40 garrison lead. NOT a Bear rally lead (use Rosa).

conquest.name: Gilded Barrage
conquest.effect: Fires a coin bullet at the enemy BACK ROW (heroes first), dealing Attack × 252% AoE damage and reducing targets' Attack Speed by 50% for 2s (at L5). Her signature meta-shifter: bypasses front-line meat shields to kill enemy back-row damage dealers before their tanks fall.

conquest.name: Lucky Strike
conquest.effect: Fires at an enemy (heroes first), dealing Attack × 140% damage with a 50% chance to deal DOUBLE damage (at L5). Single-target, hero-prioritizing.

conquest.name: Priceless Shot
conquest.effect: Unleashes a hail of massive coin bullets, dealing Attack × 49% damage per second to enemies within range for 3s (at L5).

expedition.name: Crouching Tiger
expedition.effect: All squads' attacks increase enemy damage taken by 25% (at L5). Her ELITE priority skill: uses a rare skill code that MULTIPLIES with standard attack/lethality buffs from other joiners rather than adding to them — this is what makes her a top-tier joiner for Bear Hunt and PvP.

expedition.name: Focus Fire
expedition.effect: Grants all squads' attacks 100% extra damage after every four attacks, and causes the target to receive 15% extra damage on its next attack received (at L5). Complex 4-turn counter that advances fastest when all three troop types are present. HIDDEN DRAWBACK: when rally leading, the 15% component OVERRIDES her 1st skill's stronger 25% Crouching Tiger debuff for that turn (a weaker version), reducing efficiency.

expedition.name: Trap of Greed
expedition.effect: Her Archers deal 60% extra damage to ALL enemies on the next attack of every 4 attacks (at L5). Hits all enemy troop types at once. Weird interaction: its bonuses can OVERWRITE her 1st skill (Crouching Tiger) the turn after. NEUTRALIZED in Bear Hunt because the Bear is coded as infantry-only.

exclusive_gear.name: Lucky Spinner

gear_skills.name: Refined Gunplay
gear_skills.effect: Deals Attack × 70% damage to a random enemy each time she casts a skill (heroes first) (at Lv9). Widget ability that mildly supports her early back-row targeting.

gear_skills.name: Money Driven
gear_skills.effect: Increases Defender Squad Defense by 15% (at Lv10). The game's THIRD defensive archer widget (multiplicative defense bonus to garrisons she leads) — same alignment as Zoe/Long Fei, so she leads garrisons, not Bear rallies.

exclusive_gear.note: Highest base hero_attack in the game upon release (1,212 gear / 5,987 at 5-star max), fueling her back-row sniping. Defensive widget (Money Driven), so she is a garrison lead/joiner, not a Bear rally lead.

details.strategy: Gen 5 defensive archer specialist and the game's premier back-row sniper. EXPEDITION: her value is as a JOINER, not a rally lead. Her priority skill Crouching Tiger (+25% enemy damage taken) uses a rare code that MULTIPLIES with other joiners' attack/lethality buffs (like Eric's Holy Warrior, Fahd's Desert Eclipse, Rosa's Chaos Gambit), making her an elite Bear Hunt and PvP joiner. She is a POOR Bear rally lead: her defensive widget and turn-counter-reliant skills (Focus Fire needs a 4-turn counter) are inefficient over the 10-turn Bear simulation, Trap of Greed is neutralized by the Bear being infantry-only, and Focus Fire's hidden clause even downgrades her own 25% debuff to 15% on some turns — so AVOID her over Rosa for Bear rally leading. She shines in alliance garrisons that do NOT use the 60/40 formation. CONQUEST/ARENA: she is meta-shifting. Gilded Barrage (252% AoE) bypasses front-line tanks to strike the enemy back-row damage dealers (heroes first) with a -50% attack speed debuff, systematically dismantling the opponent's most lethal threats while their frontline is still standing. Refined Gunplay (70% to a random enemy on each skill cast) and Lucky Strike (140%, 50% chance to double, hero-first) reinforce her assassin role. She joins top-tier Gen 5 Arena teams.
details.investment: A spender hero — primarily via the Hall of Heroes or Daily Packs (or orange/general hero shards). Build her as a Bear/PvP JOINER (her Crouching Tiger code is elite) and as a Conquest/Arena back-row sniper, not as a Bear rally lead (Rosa is better). Good in non-60/40 garrisons. Her skill interactions are extremely complex (Focus Fire / Trap of Greed can overwrite Crouching Tiger) — the full video guide is recommended for exact turn-by-turn behavior.
details.story: Story I: The only child of the fabulously wealthy Ostervilts, young Vivian wanted for nothing — no jewelry too expensive, no toy out of reach — except her absent parents' love. Endless attendants and gifts compensated for her loneliness. She rebelled against her parents' strict schooling, wanting to study the chaos of life out in the streets, marketplaces and alleys, where the stories roamed and adventurers shared tales of the world beyond her gated estate.

entries.name: Thrud
entries.summary: Gen 5 offensive cavalry hero with a unique Expedition/Arena move set that changes the usual enemy targeting sequence — hits all three troop types at once and disrupts back rows with AoE + stuns.

details.role_focus: Offensive cavalry ATTACK rally lead (2nd offensive cavalry widget) and 60/40 garrison alternative to Margot; premier Gen 5 Conquest/Arena AoE disruptor. NOT a Bear rally lead (Petra stays best-in-slot).

conquest.name: Axe Flurry
conquest.effect: Hurls five axes at random targets (heroes first), dealing Attack × 84% AoE damage (at L5). Five attacks bypass the front line to pressure back-row damage dealers early; random targeting means it can't reliably clear the backline alone. Upgraded to stun by the Berserker's Edge gear skill.

conquest.name: Brutal Throw
conquest.effect: Throws a spinning axe, dealing Attack × 70% damage to enemies within range and STUNNING them for 1.5s (at L5). Guaranteed AoE stun (crowd control).

conquest.name: Feast of the Pack
conquest.effect: A primal howl increasing all squads' attack by 5% (at L5). Team-wide active attack buff; a 6s delay means faster heroes may fire ultimates before receiving it, but broad impact keeps it valuable.

expedition.name: Battle Hunger
expedition.effect: Inspires her INFANTRY and ARCHERS (not cavalry), reducing their damage taken by 15% and increasing their damage dealt by 15% (at L5). Her priority skill — the FEWER cavalry in formation, the better its value (odd mismatch with her cavalry-focused skills).

expedition.name: Reckless Charge
expedition.effect: Her CAVALRY has a 20% chance to deal 100% extra damage to ALL enemies on attack (~20% effective at L5). Unique targeting: strikes ALL THREE enemy troop types simultaneously — making it ~3x stronger AND letting her damage enemy cavalry and archers BEFORE the infantry line falls (a significant PvP Expedition targeting shift). Cavalry-only, which mismatches her cavalry-ignoring 1st skill.

expedition.name: Ancestral Guidance
expedition.effect: For every 4 attacks made by CAVALRY, all squads' damage dealt +25% and damage taken -25% for 2 turns (at L5). Requires advancing a 4-turn counter (relies on cavalry being present), so it is weak in early turns.

exclusive_gear.name: Bloodfang

gear_skills.name: Berserker's Edge
gear_skills.effect: While releasing Axe Flurry, Thrud has a 35% chance to STUN the targets (at Lv9). Adds crowd control on top of her AoE — a well-timed stun can negate an enemy ultimate and swing a battle.

gear_skills.name: Wolf-Kissed
gear_skills.effect: Increases rally squads' lethality by 15% (at Lv10). The game's SECOND offensive cavalry widget — a multiplicative rally-lead lethality bonus (OFFENSIVE alignment, unlike Margot's defensive Pugilist), marking her as an attack rally lead.

exclusive_gear.note: Offensive cavalry widget (Wolf-Kissed), so she is an ATTACK rally lead. In the 60/40 garrison she is a high-stat replacement for Margot (though she lacks a defensive widget); her higher cavalry base stats plus preemptive shredding of attacking archers/cavalry make her a surprisingly strong defensive option vs opponents who under-built cavalry health/defense.

details.strategy: Gen 5 OFFENSIVE cavalry specialist for attack rally leaders, powered by the game's second offensive cavalry widget (Wolf-Kissed, +15% multiplicative lethality). Her kit has an odd split: Battle Hunger buffs infantry/archers (better with FEWER cavalry), while Reckless Charge and Ancestral Guidance are cavalry-dependent. Reckless Charge's unique all-three-troop-type targeting is the standout — ~3x stronger and able to damage enemy cavalry and archers before the infantry line falls, a real PvP Expedition shift. BEAR HUNT: a poor choice vs Petra — the Bear is coded as 10 turns against 5,000 infantry only, which neutralizes Reckless Charge's multi-target advantage, dampens Ancestral Guidance (turn-counter wait), and the low cavalry fraction in Bear formations means her cavalry stats can't displace Petra as best-in-slot. 60/40 GARRISON: a high-stat alternative to Margot; despite lacking a defensive widget, her higher cavalry base stats and preemptive shredding of attacking archers/cavalry make her a strong defensive pick against opponents who under-built cavalry health/defense. CONQUEST/ARENA: an AoE disruptor with the 2nd-highest base attack in her generation. Axe Flurry (five random hero-first attacks) bypasses the front line to pressure back-row dealers early; Berserker's Edge upgrades it with a stun chance that can negate enemy ultimates. Brutal Throw adds a guaranteed 1.5s AoE stun, and Feast of the Pack a team-wide attack buff — an instant top-team Gen 5 pick.
details.investment: Primarily earned via Featured Hero rewards (Strongest Governor, Kingdom of Power/KvK) or built with orange/general hero shards. Build her as an OFFENSIVE cavalry attack rally lead, a 60/40 garrison alternative to Margot, and a Conquest/Arena AoE disruptor. Do NOT expect her to replace Petra for Bear Hunt. Her all-three-target Reckless Charge and stun-heavy Conquest kit make her an instant top-team Gen 5 hero.
details.story: Story I — 'Here lies one born in war. Baptized by thunder, bathed in blood and broken bones; here lies one born of glory. Songbringer in the storm, upon which enemies tremble and gnash their teeth; for whom the Golden Gates stand open, until stars fall and sea overcomes land.' — Eternal Warrior, Thrud the Wolf-Kissed.

entries.name: Yang
entries.summary: Gen 6 archer with a perfectly aligned kit for Bear Hunt and Arena AoE — the premier offensive archer of her generation and meta-relevant through Gen 7.

details.role_focus: Premier Gen 6 offensive archer Bear Hunt/PvP rally lead (best archer damage dealer through Gen 7) and mandatory Conquest/Arena backline anchor with instant-defeat mechanics.

conquest.name: Kin Throw
conquest.effect: Delivers a Frostkin snowboard/shuriken in a straight line, dealing Attack × 140% AoE damage PLUS the same amount on its return path (double-hit) (at L5). Her signature: hits the formation both outbound and inbound.

conquest.name: Combo
conquest.effect: 35% chance to inflict a combo shot, dealing another round of damage to enemies (at L5).

conquest.name: Deadshot
conquest.effect: 15% Crit Rate when dealing damage (at L5). Crits act as 'fatal blows' that instantly defeat non-hero units (escorts) — unique escort-clearing synergy with the Quick Draw knockdown, and gives her long-term Arena relevance via the crit mechanic.

expedition.name: Avalanche
expedition.effect: Every 4 turns, all squads deal an additional strike against a target for 100% damage (~25% average increase at L5). Her priority skill. Shares a 'damage up' code with Ice Zone and stacks ADDITIVELY with it.

expedition.name: Ice Zone
expedition.effect: Her ARCHERS have a 40% chance to deal 100% extra damage with every attack (~40% average archer damage boost at L5). Shares the 'damage up' code with Avalanche (stacks additively).

expedition.name: Ambush
expedition.effect: 40% chance to increase Squad's Damage Dealt by 50% (at L5). CRITICALLY, this uses a SEPARATE skill code that stacks MULTIPLICATIVELY with her other two damage skills — the source of her 25-30% higher Bear Hunt scores over a fully-built Rosa.

exclusive_gear.name: Frostkin

gear_skills.name: Quick Draw
gear_skills.effect: A five-shot barrage dealing Attack × 56% damage to a random enemy; if the target is an Escort, a chance to instantly KNOCK THEM DOWN (at Lv9). The knockdown acts as a 'fatal blow' for instant escort clearing (pairs with Deadshot crits).

gear_skills.name: Offensive Defense
gear_skills.effect: Increases Rally Squad's Lethality by 15% (at Lv10). A standard OFFENSIVE archer lethality widget — same archetype as Rosa and Marlin, marking her as an attack rally lead.

exclusive_gear.note: Gen 6 gear power jumps to 600,750 with +133.50% expedition stats (vs Gen 5's 499,500 / +111.00%). Offensive archer widget (Offensive Defense), and the HIGHEST base attack in the game for her generation.

details.strategy: The Gen 6 offensive archer and most impactful offensive investment of her generation. EXPEDITION (Bear Hunt/PvP): an attack rally lead using the archetypal Rosa/Marlin +15% offensive lethality widget. Her kit is pure damage: Avalanche (100% every 4 turns, ~25% avg) and Ice Zone (~40% avg archer damage) share a 'damage up' code and stack ADDITIVELY, but Ambush (40%/+50%) uses a SEPARATE code that stacks MULTIPLICATIVELY — the key interaction that yields a massive 25-30% higher Bear Hunt score than a fully-built Rosa. Because the Gen 7 archer (Wee & Woo) is a DEFENSIVE-widget hero that is slow to max on the Roulette Wheel, Yang's spot as the premier archer damage dealer is virtually guaranteed through the end of Gen 7 — a high-value investment for those with stored legendary shards. CONQUEST/ARENA: a premier backline damage dealer leveraging the highest base attack in the game for her generation. Kin Throw double-hits (out and back) for 2×140%. She uniquely clears escorts with 'instant defeat' mechanics: Deadshot's 15% crit rate and Quick Draw's escort knockdown both act as fatal blows on non-hero units. This field-clearing plus her base-stat advantage give her far more Arena longevity than frontline heroes like Triton; she lacks Sophia's crowd control but her raw damage and instant-defeat mechanics make her a mandatory Gen 6 backline anchor.
details.investment: Earned via Featured Hero rewards; a standout immediate-ROI investment, ideal for players with stored legendary shards. Build her as the Gen 6 offensive archer Bear Hunt/PvP rally lead (beats a fully-built Rosa by 25-30% Bear score via her multiplicative Ambush code) and as a mandatory Arena/Conquest backline anchor. Her relevance holds through Gen 7 since Wee & Woo (Gen 7 archer) is defensive and slow to build.
details.story: Story I — In the frozen wilds, 'Yang' is a legend carried on every icy wind: the 'Winter Huntress' whose reputation echoes across the endless snowfields. People trust her not only because she can track any beast or navigate the worst storms, but because she never loses her head in a crisis — first to take charge finding shelter, reading the winds, building a fire, calmly organizing everyone's escape. The harsh polar climate only made her more clearheaded. Yet she has a mischievous streak, cracking jokes around the campfire or building goofy snowmen with her board, knowing that out here losing your nerve is far more dangerous than any blizzard.

entries.name: Triton
entries.summary: Gen 6 defensive infantry hero whose description sounds great but is underwhelming in practice — carried entirely by massive base health/defense stats, not his skills.

details.role_focus: Defensive garrison tank and first dedicated DEFENSE-only PvP rally joiner; carried by huge base health/defense stats that displace Long Fei. NOT for Bear Hunt. High-spender-only pick.

conquest.name: Tidewill
conquest.effect: Surrounds himself with a wave barrier that surges forward, gaining INVULNERABILITY for 2s before dealing Attack × 140% AoE damage (at L5). The 2s invulnerability is his most future-proof trait — a potential stalling tactic that may stay relevant until a future infantry hero copies it.

conquest.name: Regal Wrath
conquest.effect: Increases his Attack by 24% and Defense by 48% for 4s (~50% uptime buff) (at L5).

conquest.name: Striking Hit
conquest.effect: Deals Attack × 28% damage to a random enemy with every normal attack (at L5). Pressures the backline with random procs.

expedition.name: Command of Power
expedition.effect: Increases total Squads' Defense by 25% (at L5). His priority skill and the game's FIRST dedicated DEFENSE-only rally joiner ability — mild long-term PvP joiner utility.

expedition.name: Warfare of Power
expedition.effect: Nominally increases total Squads' skill damage dealt by 30% (at L5), BUT testing reveals a RED HERRING: it only affects 'active' damage-dealing hero abilities and IGNORES 'passive' bonuses like Chenko's lethality — severely undercutting its real value.

expedition.name: Oath of Power
expedition.effect: Increases Infantry Health by 20% and Cavalry/Archer Health by 30% (at L5). POORLY optimized: it gives LESS health (20%) to infantry — the troops in a garrison that most need it — and more (30%) to cavalry/archers.

exclusive_gear.name: Tidal Scepter

gear_skills.name: Magnetic Reformation
gear_skills.effect: Grants Triton 30% increased damage (at Lv9).

gear_skills.name: Whale Call
gear_skills.effect: Increases Defender Squad Defense by 15% (at Lv10). Continues the trend of FIVE consecutive generations of defensive infantry widgets (multiplicative garrison defense) — same alignment as Zoe/Long Fei.

exclusive_gear.note: Gen 6 gear power 600,750 / +133.50%. Defensive infantry widget (Whale Call). His enormous base health (18,022 gear / 99,910 at 5-star max) and defense are what carry him — NOT his skills, which oddly try to bolster his weakest stat (attack) and mis-allocate health away from infantry.

details.strategy: A defensive infantry hero with a defensive widget and two defensive skills — best in defensive garrison formations where the high infantry share benefits most from his base stats. His priority Command of Power (+25% defense) is the FIRST dedicated defense-only rally joiner, giving mild long-term PvP joiner utility. But his kit is a mixed bag: Warfare of Power is a RED-HERRING skill (its 30% 'skill damage' only applies to active damage abilities, ignoring passive lethality like Chenko's), and Oath of Power is mis-allocated (only +20% health to infantry vs +30% to cavalry/archers). His massive base health/defense let him outperform a fully-built Long Fei in both offensive and defensive rallies, but he offers almost NO Bear Hunt value (defensive widget + no offensive contribution to the non-infantry troops doing most of the Bear damage). He does well in SOLO MARCHES thanks to his diverse skill codes and the symmetric offense/defense reward of that mode. ARENA/CONQUEST: nominally a damage-dealing melee hero (Tidewill 2s invuln + AoE, Regal Wrath ~50% uptime +24% atk/+48% def, Striking Hit 28% backline procs) but this role is flawed — his base attack is only slightly above Gen 4 Margot and the Arena doesn't reward a frontline damage dealer. His true value is his huge health/defense, guaranteeing a Gen 6 top-team slot even though his skills bolster his weakest stats. Poor meta longevity vs Sophia or Yang; likely replaced by future infantry tanks like Charles, though Tidewill's 2s invulnerability may remain a useful stalling tactic.
details.investment: Available via Hall of Heroes and Daily Deals. A necessary investment ONLY for high-spending players responsible for holding defensive garrisons. F2P players who already built Long Fei can safely PASS on him — his skill kit is underwhelming and his edge is purely the raw base-stat advantage. Build for garrison defense and as a defense-only PvP joiner, never for Bear Hunt.
details.story: Story I — Triton was discovered by a soldier of fortune in the Temple of Tides. In a long-sealed secret chamber, air too cold and salt-heavy for the region blew out amid grinding ancient machinery. At its center sat an enormous metal 'cabinet' ringed by concentric canals; a semi-transparent blue liquid pooled through them until the room flashed in impossible yellows, reds and whites. Then a man of formidable build — no younger than 40, with white hair still clinging to his scalp — half-fell, half-crawled from the egg-shaped cabinet, only the faint rise and fall of his chest showing he still lived.

entries.name: Sophia
entries.summary: Gen 6 F2P defensive cavalry hero with a complex Expedition skillset and an Arena crowd-control focus — the first F2P-friendly defensive cavalry since Gen 1 Jabel.

details.role_focus: Best-in-slot F2P 60/40 garrison defensive cavalry (beats Margot; edges Thrud) and an Arena/Conquest crowd-control disruptor whose kit scales with future power. NOT a Bear rally lead.

conquest.name: Puppet Master
conquest.effect: Deals Attack × 140% AoE damage and CONFUSES enemies for 1s (at L5). Confused enemies attack ALL surrounding targets, friend and foe — when it hits the enemy backline, they effectively destroy themselves. Her defining Arena mechanic.

conquest.name: Scalding Mark
conquest.effect: Deals Attack × 70% damage and applies Scalding Mark, increasing the target's damage taken by 6% (from ALL enemies) for 4s (at L5). A team-wide damage amplifier.

conquest.name: Scalding Mark - Lash
conquest.effect: Scalding Marks boost Sophia's own Attack by 24% and let her Lash afflicted targets for 12% increased damage (at L5). Somewhat SELFISH modifier — the Lash bonus only boosts her own damage to marked targets, not the team's.

expedition.name: Arcane Pact
expedition.effect: 40% chance each turn to reduce all squad damage received by 50% (at L5). A powerful defensive staple, but it SHARES a skill code with Long Fei's Above And Beyond / Mighty Paragon family — limiting synergy if the two are used together.

expedition.name: Terror - Deathblow
expedition.effect: Chance to inflict TERROR on enemies every 2 turns; terrified targets receive 200% increased CAVALRY damage on the following turn (Terror lasts 1 turn) (at L5). The setup half of her signature terror combo.

expedition.name: Terror - Annihilation
expedition.effect: All Squads deal 75% increased damage to Terrified targets (all troop types, at L5). The payoff half of the terror combo. Together the two Terror skills average ~37.5% damage increase — but need LONGER battles (PvP rallies) to reach it.

exclusive_gear.name: Scarlet Rose

gear_skills.name: Eyes of Obedience
gear_skills.effect: Attacks have an 8% chance to CONFUSE the target for 1s (at Lv9). Confused enemies attack all surrounding targets, friend and foe — reinforces her Puppet Master disruption on every normal attack.

gear_skills.name: Queen of Night
gear_skills.effect: Increases Defender Squad's Lethality by 15% (at Lv10). A DEFENSIVE-activating lethality widget (garrison), which is why she is a 60/40 defender, not a Bear rally lead.

exclusive_gear.note: Gen 6 gear power 600,750 / +133.50%. DEFENSIVE-activating cavalry lethality widget (Queen of Night). Base attack (1,201 gear / 5,926 at 5-star max) is nearly equal to top Gen 5 archer Vivian, fueling her Arena disruptor role.

details.strategy: The Gen 6 Roulette Wheel cavalry — the most accessible hero of her generation and the FIRST F2P-friendly defensive cavalry since Gen 1's Jabel. EXPEDITION: her priority Arcane Pact (40%/-50% damage) is a strong defensive staple but shares a code with Long Fei (limited synergy together). Her unique value is the Terror combo: Terror-Deathblow applies terror (+200% cavalry damage next turn) and Terror-Annihilation adds +75% all-troop damage to terrified targets, averaging ~37.5% — but it needs LONGER battles (PvP rallies) to pay off. She is UNSUITABLE for Bear Hunt: a defensive-activating widget, a long-battle kit, and one skill that doesn't interact with the bear due to coding. For 60/40 GARRISON defense she is best-in-slot for spenders, easily beating Margot (superior base stats + cavalry buffs); vs Thrud it's closer — Sophia gives better overall results, but Thrud spreads enemy losses better across archers/cavalry depending on setup. ARENA/CONQUEST: a high-attack crowd-control disruptor (base attack near Gen 5 Vivian). Puppet Master's CONFUSED status forces enemies to attack their own allies — devastating on the backline — reinforced by her Eyes of Obedience widget (confusion on normal attacks) and Scalding Mark (team-wide +damage-taken). Scalding Mark-Lash is a bit selfish (boosts only her own damage). Her CC + damage-amplification scale with the power of future heroes (both allies and enemies), giving her better Arena longevity than Triton; like Petra (Gen 3), her injected randomness makes her a decent pick for clearing tricky Conquest Stages.
details.investment: The most accessible Gen 6 hero via the Hero Roulette (F2P), and the first F2P defensive cavalry since Jabel. Build her for 60/40 garrison defense (best-in-slot for spenders, beats Margot, edges Thrud) and as an Arena/Conquest CC disruptor with strong scaling longevity. Avoid her for Bear Hunt. Beware stacking her with Long Fei (shared damage-reduction code).
details.story: Story I — Nightfall could not hide the magnificence of the approaching envoy: four great horses pulling a black carriage so dark it seemed a portal into absolute darkness, reflecting no light. Its occupant stepped down with a deep sigh — a noble lady in a dark dress and bodice, albino-white skin contrasting with magnificent red hair and a hat pinned with a scarlet rose. She regarded the staring villagers with a coolness not without warmth, and the crowd hung on her every husky word. Her few guardsmen were hardly an honor escort — how had they crossed rebellious, war-torn lands without a brigade? Such questions could wait; the great welcome feast would shortly begin.

entries.name: Ava
entries.summary: Gen 7 offensive cavalry hero — get her for Bear Hunt and never look back. Jokingly called the 'new Amadeus for bear' thanks to a pure-offense kit + widget.

details.role_focus: Premier Gen 7 offensive cavalry Bear Hunt rally lead ('new Amadeus for bear') and best-in-slot Bear JOINER (new damage-up skill code); pure offensive profile.

conquest.name: Color Bomb
conquest.effect: Envelops an area, dealing Attack × 70% damage to nearby enemies every 0.5s for 3s (at L5). Sustained AoE zone.

conquest.name: Corruption Bomb
conquest.effect: Detonates a corrosive pigment combo, dealing Attack × 35% damage every 0.5s and increasing the target's damage taken by 25% for 2s (at L5). Damage-amp debuff.

conquest.name: Disguise Pigment
conquest.effect: The right color combo confuses enemies, granting Ava 75% increased Defense (at L5). Her only defensive/self-survival tool in an otherwise pure-offense kit.

expedition.name: Dissolution
expedition.effect: Reduces total enemy Defense by 25% (at L5). One of her three damage-increasing expedition skills.

expedition.name: Chiaroscuro

details.strategy: PRELIMINARY (testing ongoing) — the Gen 7 offensive cavalry and a standout investment of her generation thanks to a rare, PURE-offense profile. Jokingly the 'new Amadeus for bear': one of the few heroes with THREE separate damage-increasing expedition skills (Dissolution -25% enemy defense, Chiaroscuro +50% enemy damage taken, Light and Cold +25% lethality) paired with an offensive widget (Color Storm), averaging a long-term ~25% damage increase. Testing confirms her Chiaroscuro turn-counter skill works correctly against the Bear (many counter skills get neutralized). She benefits from Gen 7's ~20% absolute power jump AND may have even GREATER Bear longevity than Yang: because the cavalry fraction in Bear formations is typically small, her superior offensive skillset stays relevant long after her base stats are surpassed. Her Light and Cold joiner ability introduces a NEW damage-up skill code, keeping her best-in-slot as a Bear JOINER (offensive and defensive rallies) even after she's replaced as a primary rally lead. Get her for Bear Hunt and never look back.
details.investment: Available via Hall of Heroes. A top-tier Gen 7 Bear Hunt investment — primary offensive cavalry rally lead AND best-in-slot Bear joiner via her unique damage-up code. Continues the archer Bear lineage's cavalry counterpart (Petra held cavalry Bear through Gen 6; Ava is the next cavalry step). Analysis is preliminary and may update as testing lands.

details.strategy: PRELIMINARY (testing ongoing) — the Gen 7 defensive infantry, continuing the long trend of infantry with a defensive widget. Disappointing to theorycrafters: his first two expedition skills are capped at just 20% (below the 25% benchmark). A key design flaw is Iron Bodies' 20% damage reduction — because defensive skills sit in the combat formula's DENOMINATOR, it acts merely like a +20% health increase, not a true multiplier. His saving grace is Intimidation (enemy lethality -20%), an unusual JOINER code that likely multiplies with other skills (like Fahd/Eric), partly offsetting the 20% cap. Early Charles-vs-Triton testing is conflicting: Charles looks like an upgrade in 60/40 formations using Thrud and Saul, while Triton kept superior synergy in setups with Wee & Woo. Despite weak abilities, the massive Gen 7 power leap (~110% infantry stat improvement) is often enough to offset his mechanical shortcomings. Net: a NICHE investment for defensive-garrison leaders; most players should exercise caution or pass and wait for the likely Gen 8 Hero Roulette infantry.
details.investment: Available via Featured Hero. details.strategy: PRELIMINARY (testing ongoing) — the Gen 7 Roulette Wheel archer pair, the most accessible Gen 7 hero for F2P and the FIRST defensive archer wheel hero since Saul (Gen 1). EXPEDITION: primarily defensive specialists, but the Gen 7 stat creep is so large they come CLOSE to Yang even in offensive settings. Their priority Artillermen skill is unique — it splits joiner stats across +15% Attack and +10% Lethality (vs traditional lethality-only), giving a more balanced rally distribution and making them ideal for stacking MULTIPLICATIVE codes in Bear Hunt. Their defensive widget (Landmines) makes them less suited to LEADING Bear formations, but their huge Gen 7 base stats + THREE offensive skills can offset the missing offensive widget — viable as a pinch Bear rally lead, especially for players who skipped Yang (their ~110% archer stat advantage nearly offsets Yang's widget-type edge). For spenders they are a best-in-slot 60/40 garrison upgrade over Saul, and high-utility for lower spenders in multi-team modes like Swordland, Tri-Alliance Clash and Mystic Trial (the latter two where widget abilities don't apply). ARENA/CONQUEST: one of the most BROKEN kits to date, with the highest base attack in the game for their generation AND an AoE basic attack. High Ground (420% AoE) and Incendiaries (AoE + burn crater) can devastate a whole formation, augmented by Frontal Support (self +26% attack) and Zero Sympathy (field-wide +14% attack speed) — a dominant backline anchor.
details.investment: The most accessible Gen 7 hero via the Hero Roulette (F2P) — a MANDATORY pickup. Build them as a 60/40 garrison archer (best-in-slot upgrade over Saul), a strong Bear joiner (balanced attack+lethality code stacks multiplicatively), a pinch Bear rally lead if you skipped Yang, and a dominant Arena/Conquest AoE anchor. Highly valuable in Swordland, Tri-Alliance Clash and Mystic Trial. Analysis is preliminary and may update.
